Role Title: Shopify Specialist

Role Type: Contractor (~5 - 10 hs/week)

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Shopify Specialists to contribute subject-matter expertise for a customer project focused on e-commerce workflows and analytics. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Review proposed Shopify and e-commerce task structures, identifying where they diverge from actual platform workflows and data models.
  2. Provide clear, actionable written and verbal feedback on the realism and completeness of analytical scenarios and deliverables.
  3. Advise on Shopify's core data objects—including orders, products, customers, and reporting—to ensure analytic tasks align with real-world use.
  4. Highlight gaps, edge cases, or unrealistic assumptions in scenario framing, drawing on direct hands-on experience.
  5. Recommend improvements to task structures, terminology, and metrics based on best practices in the Shopify and e-commerce ecosystem.
  6. Validate that terminology and definitions are consistent with standard Shopify/e-commerce analytics language.
  7. Suggest additional cases or refinements to better reflect the operator and analyst perspective.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience within the Shopify ecosystem—across store operations, development, or analytics.
  2. Comprehensive knowledge of Shopify's data model (orders, products, customers, reporting).
  3. Strong foundation in e-commerce analytics, including conversion, retention, cohort, and revenue measurements.
  4. Proven ability to communicate feedback clearly and effectively in both written and verbal forms.
  5. Direct experience advising on best practices for structuring Shopify-related analytical work.
  6. Experience with multiple Shopify stores, or as a consultant or agency professional (nice to have).
  7. Familiarity with Shopify Plus, advanced reporting, and analytical tools such as SQL or BI platforms (e.g., Looker) is a plus.

Hiring flow:

  1. AI Interview
  2. Recruiter and team members interview
  3. Offer and onboarding (if selected)

jobs.title: AI Enablement Manager (Reproductive Healthcare - 12 month fixed term)
jobs.excerpt: Organizational SummaryContraceptive care is basic healthcare.
jobs.description:
Organizational Summary

Contraceptive care is basic healthcare. Yet too many patients in the U.S. struggle to access the care they need, when they need it. Founded in 2014, Upstream USA is a national, nonpartisan nonprofit dedicated to ensuring that equitable, patient-centered contraceptive care is available to everyone.

Our Mission and Impact

Upstream works to ensure individuals can make fully informed, autonomous decisions about the contraceptive methods that are best for them. We are currently the largest contraceptive organization in the country improving contraceptive care in primary care settings, operating in 37 states and Washington, D.C.

While our foundational work focuses on partnering with healthcare organizations offering primary care, such as federally qualified healthcare centers (FQHC) and health systems, we are always evolving. We are actively pursuing additional, innovative paths to ensure every patient has streamlined access to the contraceptive service of their choice, where and when it is most convenient for them.

A Different Kind of Nonprofit

Supported entirely by venture philanthropy, Upstream operates with a culture of aggressive growth and a laser focus on measurable outcomes. To maintain our independence and nonpartisan stance, we do not accept funding from the government or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Our 2030 Goal: We are on a mission to partner with organizations that collectively reach 5 million patients of reproductive age.
  • Recognition: We are a 2023 Audacious Project recipient, with our work featured in publications like Harvard Public Health, Bloomberg, and MedPage Today.

We welcome individuals who are driven by impact and scale to join us in making equitable contraceptive access a reality for all.

This is a fully benefited, full-time Upstream USA position that has been funded for 12 months from date of hire. There is the possibility of extension or conversion to a continuing position, contingent upon performance meeting the needs of the department, organizational need, and the continued availability of funding designated to support the position.

Position Summary

Upstream is scaling its use of AI across the organization: in program delivery and practice transformation, partnership success, development, finance, marketing and communications, and within the technology team itself. Reporting to the Director of Data, Analytics and Technology (DAT), this role is a hands-on, forward-deployed position that will embed directly with teams across Upstream to understand how their work gets done, identify where AI can help (and where it doesn't), build working solutions, and stay with those solutions through adoption and measurement.

This is a manager/builder/coach role: you will discover and prioritize use cases, prototype and deliver practical tools, and develop the training and resources that raise AI fluency organization-wide, all while leading tool evaluations, guardrails, and cost stewardship that keep our AI footprint responsible and sustainable.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Use Case Discovery & Prioritization

  • Embed with teams across Upstream to understand end-to-end workflows, undocumented processes, and the manual work that slows them down.
  • Identify, scope, and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, adoption potential, and risk.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into clearly defined use cases, solution hypotheses, and build plans.
  • Exercise judgment about what is worth building — including recommending against AI when a simpler process change or an existing tool solves the problem.

Solution Building & Delivery

  • Design, build, test, and deploy practical AI-enabled solutions — prompts, skills, agents, automations, and lightweight applications — using Upstream's approved AI tools, platforms and enterprise data.
  • Prototype rapidly, put working solutions in front of real users quickly, and iterate based on feedback and observed usage.
  • Build and curate a reusable library of prompts, skills, templates, and workflow components so that solutions compound rather than live in one person's hands.
  • Partner with DAT colleagues to transition validated prototypes into supported, production-ready solutions when scale or sensitivity warrants it.
  • Document solution requirements, configurations, operating procedures, and expected outcomes.

Enablement, Training & Adoption

  • In collaboration with other DAT team members, develop and deliver Upstream's AI training program — workshops, office hours, self-paced content, and role-specific guidance — so Upstreamers across every function use AI effectively, safely, and confidently.
  • Create and maintain user-facing resources including documentation, quick-start guides, best practices, and the Upstream AI Hub.
  • Cultivate a network of AI champions across departments who drive adoption within their own teams.
  • Surface and share wins — quantified time savings, before/after workflows, and lessons learned — to build organizational momentum.
  • Support change management for new AI tools and ways of working, meeting people where they are and building trust with skeptics as well as enthusiasts.

Governance, Tools & Measurement

  • Serve as Upstream's internal subject matter expert across our evolving AI and automation ecosystem.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and connectors; recommend what to adopt, pilot, or decline, in partnership with DAT leadership.
  • Partner with DAT, Finance, and Contracts colleagues on license administration, provisioning, vendor review, cost tracking, and renewal planning for AI tools.
  • Help establish and maintain practical guardrails covering data privacy, PHI and sensitive-data handling, appropriate use, and human review — and educate Upstreamers on them.
  • Define and track success metrics tied to real outcomes: time saved, quality improvements, usage, and adoption; report progress to DAT and organizational leadership.

Additional duties as assigned

Required Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Ability

Upstream fosters a mission-oriented workplace and welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. The ideal candidate upholds our mission of accessible, patient-centered contraceptive care, builds trust through empathy and honesty, and contributes to a collaborative culture. They bring enthusiasm to their work, creating opportunities for connection and celebration.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, technology, internal tools, business process improvement, automation, consulting, or a closely related field, including hands-on work delivering AI or automation solutions in a business setting.
  • Demonstrated hands-on ability to build with modern AI tooling — LLM platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT, prompt and skill development, agentic workflows, and automation or low-code/no-code platforms. This role requires a practitioner, not only a strategist.
  • Proven track record translating ambiguous business needs into practical, working solutions, and moving from problem discovery to a usable result quickly.
  • Experience developing and delivering training, documentation, or enablement programs that changed how people actually work.
  • Comfort working with data from multiple systems, both structured and unstructured, and enough fluency with SQL or equivalent to investigate and validate independently.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and to present clearly to senior leadership.
  • Ability to build trust and influence without direct authority, across every level of the organization.
  • Self-directed and highly organized, with the judgment to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and to prioritize in a fast-moving environment.
  • AI Fluency & Tool Integration: Ability to identify and leverage generative AI tools (such as LLMs, image generators, or industry-specific copilots) to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance overall output quality while maintaining the proper human checkpoints.
  • AI Prompt Engineering & Critical Output Evaluation: Proficiency in crafting effective prompts to achieve desired outcomes and the critical thinking skills necessary to audit, fact-check, and refine AI-generated content for accuracy and brand alignment.
  • Ethical AI Awareness: A foundational understanding of the ethical implications of AI, including data privacy, bias recognition, and the responsible use of company information in third-party AI environments.
  • Demonstrates the ability to remain focused, adaptable, and solution-oriented in the face of challenges, setbacks, or ambiguity. Approaches obstacles with a growth mindset and maintains a steady commitment to goals, even under pressure or changing circumstances; resilient.
  • While we are a remotely based organization, we maintain an on-camera culture during meetings to support connection, engagement, teaming and collaboration. Must be comfortable and able to participate in this environment.

Valued and Non-Essential Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Ability

(Not required to apply)

  • Prior experience in an AI enablement, AI operations, internal tools, forward-deployed, or other business-embedded technical role.
  • Experience in a nonprofit, healthcare, or mission-driven organization, including familiarity with PHI and sensitive-data handling.
  • Familiarity with Upstream's core systems — Salesforce, Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, Asana, Google Workspace, Slack.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, connectors, MCP, or scripting in Python or a similar language.
  • Experience standing up enablement programs, champions networks, or internal knowledge bases.
  • Experience evaluating vendors and managing software licenses, usage tracking, or cost models.
  • Experience partnering with security, privacy, or compliance colleagues to evaluate technology.
  • A point of view on where AI does and does not belong, informed by having shipped things that worked and things that didn't.

Travel Requirements

This role will require up to 20% business travel. All Upstreamers can expect a minimum of 8 days of business travel per year to attend 1 annual organizational retreat and 1 or 2 annual team/department meetings.

Appointment End Date

This is a fully benefited, full-time Upstream USA position that has been funded for 12 months from date of hire. There is the possibility of extension or conversion to a continuing position, contingent upon performance meeting the needs of the department, organizational need, and the continued availability of funding designated to support the position.

Hiring Range

The hiring range for this role is $140,000 to $155,000.

Pay Transparency

Final offers for this position will be based upon several factors including the scope of the role, market compensation analysis, position requirements, candidate's experience level and capabilities, fairness in internal pay considerations and will be made within the parameters of Upstream USA's compensation framework and philosophy.

As part of our hybrid work practices, this travel expectation will be applicable for all Upstreamers, even those based remotely.
  • Engage in organization-sponsored learning & development.

Upstream USA offers a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long and short term disability, 401K with a match, generous vacation, personal, sick and holiday time off, parental leave, professional development, a fitness and cell phone allowance for all full time employees and part time employees who work a minimum of 24 hours per week.

Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

As the Lead Industrial Engineer, Warehouse Design, you will be responsible for leading the development of a design package that may include material flow diagrams, facility layouts, material handling equipment designs, automation designs, storage media designs, process designs, slotting, pick path analyses. Also, you will have overall responsibility for managing all engineering activities during the implementation phase including automation and material handling vendor management and systems and equipment installation and testing.

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Collaborates with Data Analytics team to analyze client data to determine order profiles, storage media application, product slotting, velocity, SKU affinities, ABC analysis
  • Prepares engineering calculations and documents to describe solution and detailed operating concepts such as storage and shipping capacity, facility sizing, zoning, slotting, waving, etc. and facilitates reviews with key work stream leads including engineering peers, WMS Implementation, and operations
  • Designs the overall facility layout, storage media, and flow paired with the appropriate equipment supporting the Concept of Operations.
  • Supports the business development process by supporting the solutions team’s response to RFPs including developing materials and presenting to potential clients
  • Evaluate and compare manual and automated warehouse solutions, develop detailed ROI, payback, and use these insights to drive data‑based warehouse layout, process, and design recommendations
  • Leads detailed engineering process on new business awards to take the design from conceptualization to full detailed design ready for implementation by performing data analyses, developing material handling specifications, working with vendors to obtain quotes, and generating a detailed, engineered AutoCAD layout with fitment into the selected facility
  • Joint Planning Sessions with client and conducts gap analysis to ensure issues are resolved; identifies changes to the scope when they occur and provides necessary documentation and escalation
  • Participates on a team responsible for the implementation of new business by preparing WMS configuration documentation that includes all needed locations, slotting, zoning, sequences for put-away and picking, and allocation rules for the facility. Supports the identification and design of new WMS and interface requirements needed for development.
  • Manages material handling and automation vendors through schedule, permitting, installation, commissioning, punch lists, etc. and validates all equipment installation, including necessary performance testing
  • Post go-live support and troubleshooting
  • Provides leadership and develop/mentor junior engineers

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field, or equivalent related work or military experience
  • 4 years of engineering experience in supply chain management, logistics, warehousing or a related field
  • Experience leading Engineering teams
  • Experience with Microsoft Office

It’d be great if you also have:

  • 8-10 years of experience as an Industrial Engineer
  • Experience with Advanced data tools like SQL, Power BI and Python
  • Extensive AutoCAD experience
  • Ability to travel up to 50%
  • Time study measurement, such as MOST, a plus
  • Third-Party Logistics (3PL) experience warehousing, distribution center or fulfillment experience

  • Project and resource management experience

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

jobs.title: Cardiology Nurse Practitioner - CST
jobs.excerpt: About UsHeartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs.
jobs.description:
About Us

    Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

About the Role

    We are currently seeking a Nurse Practitioner to join our virtual clinic supporting Central Time Zonefrom 9 am to 5 pm Monday through Friday.

    As a Nurse Practitioner at Heartbeat Health, you’ll play an integral role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered cardiovascular care through our virtual care model. This position is ideal for an experienced provider who is passionate about cardiology and comfortable independently managing complex cardiac patients in a remote environment.

    With a strong focus on Heart Failure management and Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT), you’ll assess patients, develop and adjust treatment plans, monitor disease progression, and work closely with cardiologists, primary care providers, and other members of the care team. You’ll combine clinical expertise with education, advocacy, and evidence-based practice to help patients better manage their cardiovascular health and achieve improved long-term outcomes.

  • Patient Assessment: Conduct thorough patient assessments via telehealth visits, including medical history reviews, physical examinations, and diagnostic tests, to evaluate cardiovascular health and identify cardiac conditions.

  • Diagnosis and Treatment: Formulate differential diagnoses and develop comprehensive treatment plans for patients with various cardiac issues. Prescribe medications and order diagnostic tests.

  • Disease & Heart Failure Management: Extensively manage chronic cardiovascular conditions remotely, with a heavy emphasis on advanced Heart Failure management, hypertension, arrhythmias, and coronary artery disease. Monitor patient progress, analyze real-time data, and adjust care pathways to optimize cardiac function and prevent hospital readmissions.

  • Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT): Expertly implement, titrate, and manage Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT)for heart failure and alternative complex cardiac populations, ensuring clinical practice aligns strictly with the latest ACC/AHA guidelines.

  • Education and Counseling: Educate patients and their families about cardiovascular diseases, prevention strategies, and lifestyle modifications. Provide specialized counseling on medication adherence, GDMT titration expectations, fluid/diet management, exercise, and smoking cessation.

  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cardiologists, PCPs, and other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care for patients. Discuss complex cases and participate in multidisciplinary care teams.

  • Research and Evidence-Based Practice: Stay current with the latest developments in cardiology research and incorporate evidence-based practices into patient care. Participate in research studies or quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient outcomes.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and detailed patient records, including medical histories, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries. Ensure compliance with legal and ethical standards.

  • Patient Advocacy: Serve as an advocate for patients' needs and preferences, ensuring that they receive appropriate care and support throughout their healthcare journey.

  • Continuing Education: Pursue ongoing education and professional development in the field of cardiology to stay updated on the latest advancements and maintain relevant certifications.

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance programs to monitor and improve the quality of cardiology care provided within the healthcare facility.

  • Availability: Must be able to work Monday through Friday, 9 am to 5 pm CST.

About You

  • Education: A Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) with a specialization in cardiology or a related advanced practice nursing field.

  • Experience: 3+ years of dedicated experience working as a Nurse Practitioner in an outpatient cardiology setting or clinic environment.

  • Licensure Requirement: Must hold an active, current, and unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) license (preferably in a Compact State)

  • Certification: Obtain and maintain Nurse Practitioner (NP) certification specific to cardiology from a recognized certifying body, such as the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners Certification Board (AANPCB), in a relevant Nurse Practitioner specialty (e.g., Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner or Family Nurse Practitioner with a strong focus on cardiology).

  • Clinical Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in outpatient management, interpreting complex diagnostic tests (e.g., ECGs, echocardiograms), and optimizing clinical outcomes for advanced Heart Failure populations.

  • GDMT Mastery: Proven expertise in the practical application, optimization, and protocol titration of Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy (GDMT).

  • Emergency Preparedness: Certification in ACLS is required or highly recommended, as Cardiology Nurse Practitioners may be involved in emergency cardiac care protocols.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills to effectively educate patients virtually and collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team, including cardiologists and remote care coordinators.

  • Critical Decision-Making: Ability to make critical decisions, analyze complex cardiac cases, and rapidly adapt treatment plans based on patient responses and changing clinical conditions.

  • Empathy: Compassion and empathy when working with patients and their families, especially when delivering challenging diagnoses or managing chronic, life-altering cardiac conditions.

  • Detail-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail in patient assessments, virtual documentation, and treatment plans to ensure medical accuracy and patient safety.

  • Technical Agility: Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR) systems, remote patient monitoring (RPM) tools, and other digital healthcare technologies used in virtual cardiology practice.

About Our Culture

  • We are mission-driven: we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered

  • We are fast-paced & agile: we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation

  • We are remote-first: ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate

  • We care about diversity: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience

  • We care about each other: we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.

  • We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

jobs.description:
About Dura Digital

Dura Digital is a global digital transformation and consulting company that helps organizations turn emerging technologies into practical business outcomes. We bring together strategy, human-centered design, engineering, and AI expertise to create solutions that improve operations, customer experiences, and organizational performance. As a Dura Digital consultant, you will represent our commitment to thoughtful innovation, strong client partnership, and high-quality delivery while working closely with the client’s leadership and delivery teams.

About the role

We're hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and ship AI-powered features that go into production and stay there. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research role. You'll work across the full path from problem framing to deployment: turning an ambiguous business need into a working system, choosing the right model and retrieval approach, building the evaluation harness that proves it works, and standing behind it once real users depend on it.

You'll partner closely with product, design, data, and platform engineers, and depending on the engagement, directly with client stakeholders who are new to AI and need a clear-eyed guide on what's realistic.

What you'll do

  • Build and deploy production AI features: LLM-backed workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic and tool-using systems, classification and extraction pipelines, and traditional ML models where they're the better fit.
  • Own the data path behind those features: ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval quality, and improve it based on measured outcomes rather than intuition.
  • Design evaluation before you ship. Define what "good" means for each use case, build offline eval sets and online feedback loops, and track regressions as prompts, models, and data change.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications and services through well-designed APIs, with attention to latency, cost per request, failure modes, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument and monitor deployed systems for quality drift, hallucination rates, token spend, and abuse, and act on what you see.
  • Apply responsible-AI practices in day-to-day work: data privacy and residency, PII handling, prompt injection and data exfiltration risks, access control, and clear documentation of model limitations.
  • Prototype quickly to reduce uncertainty, then make a deliberate call on what deserves to be hardened and what should be thrown away.
  • Contribute to internal standards, reusable components, reference architectures, and patterns other teams can adopt.
  • Explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences, including client stakeholders and executives, without overselling what the technology can do.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 1+ years building with LLMs or ML systems in production.
  • Strong Python. Working proficiency in at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Java, or Go for service and application integration.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping an AI feature end to end, you can walk us through what you built, how you evaluated it, what broke, and what you changed.
  • Practical command of the modern LLM toolkit: prompt design, structured output, function/tool calling, context management, and at least one orchestration framework or a well-reasoned argument for building without one.
  • Experience with retrieval systems and vector search (e.g., pgvector, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Elasticsearch, or similar), including how to diagnose bad retrieval.
  • Cloud deployment experience on [Azure / AWS / GCP], plus containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code fundamentals.
  • Solid data engineering instincts: SQL, working with messy real-world data, and building pipelines that don't silently fail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort operating with incomplete requirements.

Nice to have

  • Consulting, agency, or client-facing delivery experience.
  • Fine-tuning, distillation, or parameter-efficient adaptation of open-weight models, and a sense for when it's worth it versus prompting or retrieval.
  • Experience with agent frameworks, MCP, or multi-step tool-using systems in production.
  • MLOps tooling (experiment tracking, model registries, feature stores) and observability platforms for LLM applications.
  • Background in a regulated domain such as healthcare, financial services, insurance, or the public sector.
  • Speech, vision, or document-understanding work (OCR, layout parsing, multimodal models).
  • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or conference speaking.

jobs.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Platform)

Physitrack PLC · Fully remote, based in Poland Contract: B2B contractor, EUR 8,000 per month

About us

Physitrack PLC builds digital health software used by clinicians, physiotherapists and employers in over 100 countries. Our two product lines, Physitrack (exercise prescription, telehealth and patient engagement) and Champion Health (workplace wellbeing), run on a multi-region AWS platform serving Europe, the UK, North America, Australia and the Middle East.

We are ISO 27001:2022 certified. Healthcare data brings real constraints: data residency, auditability and a low tolerance for downtime. That shapes how we build.

The role

You will own the platform our engineers ship on: the Kubernetes estate, the delivery pipelines and the cloud infrastructure under both product lines. It is a small, senior group with a wide surface area, so you will be making architectural calls rather than picking up tickets someone else has scoped.

A large part of the work is migration and consolidation. Bringing acquired products onto shared infrastructure, moving workloads between providers and regions, and retiring what we no longer need. If you enjoy taking a system someone else built and landing it cleanly on your own platform, this will suit you.

We are recruiting two senior infrastructure roles. This one covers the platform, the delivery pipelines and the migrations. The other, Senior DevOps Engineer (Security and Reliability), covers the edge, observability and cloud security posture. Apply for whichever fits, and tell us if both do.

What you will do

  • Run and evolve our multi-region AWS and EKS platform, managed as code in Terraform and deployed through ArgoCD

  • Own CI/CD across our repositories, on CircleCI and GitHub Actions, and keep the path from commit to production fast and boring

  • Lead infrastructure migrations end to end: containerising applications, moving databases between providers and regions, and cutting over with verification and a rollback plan

  • Manage PostgreSQL and RDS at production scale, covering version upgrades, instance sizing and performance work

  • Keep our Ruby on Rails runtime current, including framework upgrades, performance tuning and autoscaling behaviour

  • Own cloud cost: rightsizing, autoscaling, savings plan utilisation and a monthly cost report to Finance

  • Run disaster recovery testing and incident readiness drills, and fix what they expose

  • Act as the infrastructure point of contact for engineering, security and commercial colleagues

What we are looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineering, with meaningful time on AWS

  • Production Kubernetes, ideally EKS, well beyond having deployed to a cluster

  • Strong Terraform and an infrastructure as code instinct

  • You have run a real database migration or provider cutover, and can explain how you verified it

  • Comfortable with Linux, containers and GitOps

  • Solid scripting in Python, Go, Bash or similar, and enough application literacy to debug across the stack

  • English at a working professional level. Our engineering team is international

Nice to have

  • Ruby on Rails familiarity. Our main application is Rails

  • Cost optimisation or FinOps experience at scale

  • A regulated industry background: ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA or GDPR

  • Infrastructure consolidation following an acquisition

  • Polish. The immediate team is Warsaw based, though the company works in English

How we work

  • On-call. We run a 24/7 rotation through PagerDuty, with documented playbooks and readiness checklists. Participation is agreed with you rather than assumed, and separately compensated.

  • Cadence. Written async updates, a fortnightly planning touchpoint and a regular infrastructure and security sync. You set your own hours and choose your own tools.

  • Documentation. Runbooks, decision records and incident write ups are part of the work, not an afterthought.

  • Autonomy. Small team, wide scope, very little process between you and a decision.

jobs.description:
ADDIGY

Support Engineer, Tier 2

Role: Support Engineer, Tier 2

Commitment: Full Time

Reports To: Director of Customer Support

Location: Remote (US)

Travel: N/A

Tech Stack: G-Suite, Slack, Zoom, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence

ABOUT ADDIGY

Addigy is a fast-growing SaaS company empowering IT professionals to manage Apple devices at scale. Our platform enables organizations and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to monitor, secure, and manage macOS, iOS, and iPadOS devices in real time through a single, intuitive interface. We are guided by three core values: Humble – outcomes over ego, every time; Hungry – relentless in our pursuit of progress; and Smart – we’re curious, we dig, we never stop learning.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The Tier 2 Support Engineer is the technical backbone of Addigy's customer support organization, owning the resolution of complex, escalated issues across macOS, iPadOS, and iOS environments. You will be the resource customers and Tier 1 engineers turn to when a problem is hard, urgent, or has gone unresolved, and you will see it through to a real solution.

This role goes beyond ticket resolution. You will represent the Support team in cross-functional squad meetings, contribute to the knowledge base, mentor newer engineers, and help shape how support operates at Addigy. If you are energized by technical depth, customer impact, and continuous improvement, this is your seat.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

  • Real technical depth: You will troubleshoot complex Apple MDM, macOS, iOS, and iPadOS issues that require genuine expertise, not script-following.
  • Voice of the customer: You will represent the Support team in squad meetings alongside Product and Engineering, directly influencing how customer-impacting issues get prioritized and resolved.
  • Build something lasting: Through knowledge base contributions, process improvements, and mentoring, your work compounds beyond the tickets you close.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Customer Support & Ticket Management

  • Own a daily queue of 10-15 active support tickets, responding to customers in a timely manner and managing escalations from Tier 1 with urgency and care
  • Handle escalated tickets from Tier 1, Premium Support tickets, and multi-ticket customer situations through to full resolution
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across macOS, iPadOS, and iOS environments, proactively reaching out to customers via email, chat, or phone to understand and resolve the root cause
  • Follow standard operating procedures to ensure all issues are properly logged, documented, and escalated when needed

Collaboration & Problem Solving

  • Represent the Support team in squad meetings, reporting identified ticket trends and driving customer-impacting issues to resolution in collaboration with Product and Engineering
  • Create and manage Problem Tickets to track bugs, defects, and major product enhancements, keeping the Support team informed on progress
  • Think critically to research and identify solutions to software issues, drawing on internal documentation, external resources, and cross-functional partners

Knowledge & Enablement

  • Contribute 3-5 knowledge base articles per month in your area of expertise, creating, updating, and publishing content that improves the experience for customers and teammates alike
  • Assist with the onboarding and training of new Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support Engineers
  • Complete all required certifications on time, including Addigy Certified Associate (ACA), Addigy Certified Expert (ACE), and relevant Apple certifications
  • Continuously identify ways to improve processes, work smarter, and enhance the customer and employee experience

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 90 days, you will:

  • Take full ownership of the Tier 2 escalation queue and establish a consistent daily triage routine
  • Resolve an average of 50-60 support tickets per month with high customer satisfaction
  • Begin contributing knowledge base articles and demonstrate growing command of the Addigy platform
  • Build strong working relationships with squad teams and become a reliable voice of Support in cross-functional meetings
  • Complete ACA and ACE certifications and any required Apple training

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in a technical support, IT, or systems administration role
  • Hands-on experience with Apple MDM, including enrollment workflows, configuration profiles, Apple Business Manager, and device lifecycle management
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across macOS, iPadOS, and iOS environments
  • Proficiency with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing platform, and comfort working in Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence daily
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume ticket queue with urgency, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset

Preferred

  • Addigy Certified Associate (ACA) or Addigy Certified Expert (ACE) certification, or willingness to complete them within the first 90 days
  • Experience contributing to a support knowledge base or internal documentation
  • Background supporting MSP customers or enterprise IT environments
  • Experience mentoring or training junior support engineers

WHO YOU ARE

  • Customer-First: You take ownership of the customer's problem and do not let it fall through the cracks. White-glove service is not a phrase to you, it is how you work.
  • Critical Thinker: You are curious, resourceful, and systematic. You dig into the root cause rather than settling for a workaround.
  • Collaborative: You communicate proactively across teams, are easy to work with, and make the people around you better.
  • Continuous Learner: You pursue certifications, stay current with Apple platform changes, and actively look for ways to improve your craft and the team's processes.

COMPENSATION

Compensation includes a competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Full details will be shared during the interview process.

Addigy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're looking for a hands-on QA Lead to own end-to-end quality strategies for our customer-facing contact center and self-service technologies — including speech applications, IVRs, chat bots, and other customer service tools. You'll serve as the quality gatekeeper across functional, SIT, E2E, UAT, regression, and go-live activities, while remaining comfortable stepping in as a hands-on contributor — leading by example, not just by direction.

The ideal candidate has worked within the call center ecosystem, understands customer service operations end-to-end, and brings 8 - 10 years of experience leading QA efforts and testing teams. Experience with AWS is required and Salesforce is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Leadership

  • Be the primary quality advisor embedded in design, planning, and delivery—surface risks early, not late
  • Lead and mentor the QA team while staying hands-on in complex Contact Center and IVR testing scenarios
  • Own QA program delivery end-to-end: resource planning, test strategy, defect triage, environment coordination, and release readiness
  • Define and track Contact Center-specific quality KPIs—test coverage for call flows, automation ROI, first-call resolution testing, and cycle time
  • Design test strategies for multi-channel interactions (voice, chat, SMS), agent workflows, and failover scenarios
  • Lead go-live readiness assessments and hypercare support—triage production issues quickly and maintain a known issues log
  • Report quality status to steering committees and program reviews, framing risks in business impact (SLA, customer satisfaction, call abandonment)
  • Partner early with Product and Engineering so quality ownership spreads across the organization, not just QA
  • Apply sampling strategies, accuracy benchmarking, and prompt regression testing to validate LLM-powered and Agentic AI features; leverage GenAI tools to accelerate test case generation, documentation, and overall QA productivity

Test Design & Execution

  • Author detailed, scenario-based test cases and traceability matrices covering functional, integration, regression, and UAT cycles
  • Write thorough negative, boundary, and edge-case scenarios across IVR, chat bot, and customer service workflows — not just happy-path coverage
  • Lead exploratory testing for complex, ambiguous workflows, applying risk-based judgment to prioritize coverage where business impact is highest
  • Validate speech application (IVR) design — call flows, DTMF and speech recognition, routing logic, self-service menus, authentication, and error/timeout branches
  • Validate chat bot and conversational AI behavior — intent recognition, escalation/handoff to live agents, knowledge grounding, and response accuracy
  • Own end-to-end testing of integration layers — API request/response validation, middleware transformations, screen pops, and data sync across connected systems
  • Lead SIT, E2E, UAT, regression, and go-live testing activities across release cycles
  • Facilitate UAT readiness sessions with business stakeholders, supporting non-technical users and driving structured sign-off
  • Own the full defect lifecycle — creation, triage, prioritization, SLA tracking, root cause tagging, and trend analysis
  • Produce defect health reports and quality metrics summaries for leadership and stakeholders

Required Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of hands on experience leading QA or testing teams
  • Hands-on experience testing speech applications (IVRs), chat bots, and other customer service tools
  • Experience working within the call center/contact center ecosystem, with a solid understanding of customer service operations
  • Demonstrated ability to lead QA across functional, integration, regression, UAT, and go-live testing cycles
  • Experience building or scaling a QA program, including test strategy, governance, and reporting
  • Strong communication skills — able to represent QA status and risk to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS, particularly Amazon Connect (IVR, Lex, Contact Flows, Lambda, Contact Lens)
  • Experience with Five9, Genesys, Nuance, other telephony technologies being migrated into AWS or Service Cloud Voice
  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly Service Cloud and Service Cloud Voice
  • Exposure to conversational AI / GenAI validation — accuracy, hallucination checks, prompt/response quality, guardrails
  • Familiarity with telephony fundamentals — ACD/routing, PSTN/toll-free/DID mapping, call recording and transcription

Tools & Technical Skills

  • Test Management & Planning – Jira/Xray, Azure DevOps, Zephyr Scale, TestRail, or qTest
  • Defect Tracking & Governance –Jira for end-to-end defect lifecycle management
  • CI/CD & DevOps-Aware Testing –Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps; Git-based version control (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket)
  • Test Automation & Performance Testing –UI automation for functional/regression coverage; API testing (Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI); performance/load testing tools
  • Speech / IVR Testing –experience with tools such as Empirix Hammer or Cyara a plus
  • GenAI & Productivity Tools –Claude, Copilot, or ChatGPT for test case generation, test data creation, and QA documentation
  • Reporting & Collaboration – Confluence, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Drive, and SharePoint

Soft Skills & QA Leadership

  • Trusted Advisor Presence — Earns client confidence through expertise, transparency, and consistent delivery; comfortable challenging scope and requirements constructively when testability or clarity is lacking
  • Radical Ownership — Takes full accountability for quality outcomes across the program; doesn't wait to be told what to test next and never passes the problem to someone else
  • Hands-On Leadership — Leads by doing; equally comfortable mentoring junior team members and personally drafting and executing test cases on the same day
  • Proactive Risk Management — Anticipates quality risks, raises blockers early, and brings solutions — not just problems — to every stakeholder conversation
  • Composed Under Pressure — Navigates defect escalations, client concerns, and delivery conflicts with professionalism, sound judgment, and a calm, steady presence

jobs.excerpt: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $16 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 75 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 80,000 employees, including more than 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com

BUSINESS UNIT DESCRIPTION

Digital Data Networks (DDN) business in TE Connectivity you will play a key role in the design of products for high-speed products in the connector, cable assembly, and/or radio system industry—targeting high-speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Cyber Security Officer (Product & Embedded Systems is responsible for defining, implementing, and governing the cybersecurity strategy across all product development activities within the DDN Business Unit, with a focus on high-speed connectivity solutions used in data center environments. This role ensures that products containing integrated circuits, firmware, and embedded software are designed, validated, and maintained to mitigate cyber threats and prevent unauthorized access or exploitation.

The position operates at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and system-level architecture, addressing cybersecurity risks throughout the full product lifecycle—from concept through deployment and sustainment.

The Cyber Security Officer will define and govern the cybersecurity policies, procedures and governance model and oversee the incorporation into the LeanPD process for applicable products.

Job Requirements

1. Product Security Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and lead the business unit’s product cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
  • Establish cybersecurity policies, standards, and secure design principles for hardware, firmware, and embedded software.
  • Define security architecture requirements for high-speed connectivity products (e.g., cables, connectors, active interconnects, modules).
  • Ensure alignment with industry standards (e.g., secure development lifecycle, zero trust principles).

2. Secure Product Development Lifecycle (SPDLC)

  • Integrate cybersecurity into all phases of New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Define and enforce secure coding standards, threat modeling, and design reviews.
  • Ensure cybersecurity requirements are embedded in system and component specifications.
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement security-by-design practices.

3. Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment

  • Identify and evaluate potential attack vectors across:
    • Embedded firmware
    • ASIC/FPGA interfaces
    • High-speed data paths
    • External interfaces (I/O, management interfaces, etc.)
  • Conduct product-level threat modeling and risk assessments.
  • Define mitigation strategies and validate their effectiveness.

4. Vulnerability Management & Testing

  • Establish processes for:
    • Static and dynamic code analysis
    • Penetration testing (internal and third-party)
    • Firmware and hardware security validation
  • Lead root cause analysis and remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain vulnerability disclosure and response processes.

.

5. Supply Chain & Component Security

  • Define cybersecurity requirements for suppliers of ICs, firmware, and software components.
  • Assess third-party components for security risks (including open-source software).
  • Implement secure provisioning, authentication, and anti-tampering mechanisms.

6. Product Architecture & System Security

  • Collaborate with system architects to:
    • Design secure communication protocols
    • Implement encryption, authentication, and key management
    • Ensure secure boot, firmware integrity, and update mechanisms
  • Address risks associated with data center deployment environments (e.g., lateral movement, hardware-based attacks).

7. Incident Response & Monitoring

  • Develop and maintain product cybersecurity incident response plans.
  • Support investigation of field incidents and potential breaches involving company products.
  • Coordinate with customers and internal teams during security events.

8. Compliance & Certification

  • Ensure products meet relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards (customer-driven and regulatory).
  • Support audits, certifications, and customer security assessments.
  • Maintain documentation for compliance and traceability.

9. Training & Culture

  • Drive cybersecurity awareness across engineering and product teams.
  • Train engineers on secure design practices and emerging threats.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and advisor to leadership.

What your background should look like

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field
  • 10+ years in cybersecurity, with strong emphasis on embedded systems and/or hardware-integrated products.
  • Experience in high-speed electronics, data center infrastructure, or networking products strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience implementing secure development lifecycle practices.
  • Technical Expertise
    • Embedded systems security (firmware, RTOS, low-level software)
    • Hardware security (ASICs, FPGAs, side-channel risks, secure elements)
    • Cryptography, secure boot, authentication protocols
    • Network and data path security in high-speed systems
    • Vulnerability assessment tools and penetration testing methods
    • Secure firmware update and key management systems
  • Frameworks Knowledge
    • Secure development lifecycle frameworks
    • Product security standards relevant to data center and networking environments
    • Zero Trust Architecture concepts
  • Standards Knowledge
    • ISO/IEC 27001:2022: The premier international standard, providing a framework for setting up an Information Security Management System (ISMS) to identify and mitigate risks.
    • ISO/IEC 27017/27018: Guidelines specifically for cloud security controls and the protection of personal data in the cloud.
    • NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0: A voluntary, flexible framework focused on protecting critical infrastructure using five core functions: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond, and Recover.
    • NIST SP 800-53: Prescribes security and privacy controls for information systems, often mandatory for U.S. federal data centers.
    • SOC 2 Type II: Attestation reports that evaluate internal controls regarding security, availability, and confidentiality.
    • ANSI/TIA-942: Establishes standards for data center design, construction, and operation, including physical security requirements for Tiers 1-4.
  • Leadership & Soft Skills
    • Strong cross-functional leadership (engineering, quality, product management)
    • Ability to influence design decisions without direct authority
    • Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences
    • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capability
  • Ability to prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced dynamic work environment.
  • Willingness to travel as required, ~30%

WE VALUE

  • Knowledge in data center architecture, connectors, wire harnesses, busbars, high speed connectivity products, high voltage, electronics, measurement & signal processing.
  • Experience in product development for data center applications

#TANAUV

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Part-time, Remote in Canada)
jobs.excerpt: **Heads-up: this job will only be open until 5pm PT on Sunday, September 13, 2026 so please apply right away if interested.
jobs.description:
**Heads-up: this job will only be open until 5pm PT on Sunday, September 13, 2026 so please apply right away if interested.**

Intermediate to Senior | Remote in Canada | 6 months, Part-time Term Employee | 20 Hours per Week (Mon–Thu) | Hiring Budget: $32/hr – $40/hr

--

Hiya! We’re SimpliCity, a Vancouver-based GovTech startup building technology with purpose. Our core product is a composable content management system (CMS) that unifies municipal digital services, transforming a municipality’s website from a static library into a connected "front door" for the community. We are a small but mighty team that values diversity, curiosity, and the drive to continuously learn and improve.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to become our first dedicated QA hire. This role is a mix: hands-on manual testing where human judgment matters most, and building automations where it’s most useful. You will have the freedom and responsibility to create and implement QA processes from the ground up, from defining test strategies to recommending and setting up our automated testing tools with our engineers. Your work ensures the quality and reliability of a platform that municipalities and their residents depend on every day.

Beyond testing our own platform, over the next six months we are building an AI and automation pipeline that converts municipal website content into structured records, and you will help define what correct output looks like, judge the quality of what the AI produces, and help validate migrated content at scale. If you want your QA practice to include hands-on AI quality assurance work, this role is for you.

This is a part-time position, and we will work with you to set a weekly schedule that fits your life and our needs. If we all work together well and the company continues to grow, you would be first in line should the role continue.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop test plans and cases: Create and execute test strategies and test cases for our platform and customer project implementations.
  • Manual and automated testing across the lifecycle: You run functional and regression testing within our sprints, plus usability, cross-browser, responsive, and integration (end-to-end flow) testing across websites, web apps, and APIs, to catch issues before our customers do.
  • Testing at every stage: Test incrementally during development, verify release candidates before they ship, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with customers so high-priority issues are resolved before launch.
  • Test automation and setup: Write and maintain automated test scripts in JavaScript or TypeScript with tools like Playwright (preferred) or Cypress, and you may recommend and set up our testing tools alongside our engineers.
  • AI output validation: Define correct output for our AI content-migration pipeline, judge the quality of AI-generated records against source content, and track which items the pipeline handled versus manual work.
  • Content and migration quality: Check migrated municipal content for accuracy, structure, and metadata quality as we bring new municipalities onto the platform.
  • Web accessibility testing: Ensure customer web projects and our platform meet web accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.
  • Defect management: Identify, log, and track defects in Jira, collaborating with leadership, design, and development team members on resolution.
  • Collaborate: Provide clear updates on QA progress and support team members to ensure smooth, quality-focused delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • A QA professional with 3+ years of experience: You have tested web app and website frontends and backend APIs, both manually and with automation.
  • A process builder: You thrive in ambiguity and enjoy creating solutions and processes where none currently exist. You are motivated by the opportunity to shape the entire QA function.
  • An engineer test automation practitioner: You are proficient with tools like Playwright or Cypress, API testing tools like Postman, and SQL for database checks.
  • Comfortable in a JavaScript stack: You can read our JavaScript, NodeJS, and ReactJS codebase, debug issues, and build small internal testing tools and scripts within it.
  • An accessibility advocate: You know the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 AA+) and have experience testing for compliance, because we work with local governments and inclusive experiences are a core requirement.
  • Extremely detail-oriented and organized: You take pride in catching what others overlook, and you communicate clearly, particularly in writing.
  • A responsible AI collaborator: You are curious about using AI tools to improve testing coverage and quality, and equally comfortable judging AI output with a skeptical, evidence-based eye.

Bonus Skills and Experience

We don’t expect you to have any/all of these skills or experiences. However, if you do, be sure to highlight them when you apply.

  • Experience testing integrations and embedded third-party systems (for example a form submission and its notifications, or a data feed from a connected system).
  • Experience with performance testing and tools like JMeter and Google Lighthouse.
  • Familiarity with security testing concepts for web applications, APIs, or cloud infrastructure (we may also work with external security partners).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
  • Knowledge of or experience with content management systems, particularly headless or composable ones.
  • Relevant certifications such as ISTQB, CSQA, CSTE, or accessibility-related certifications.
  • You have worked on government-related (municipal, provincial, federal) and/or enterprise SaaS projects and products before.

Education & Certifications

  • Academic foundation: University degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience and certifications).
  • Continuous learning: You stay current with QA and accessibility practices and are interested in how AI-augmented tools can improve our testing coverage, code quality, and documentation.

Why Join Us?

  • 4-day workweek and flexibility: Our team typically works Mondays to Thursdays. We provide a flexible work environment where you can shift your hours for an appointment, swap a workday when needed, or balance caretaking and life commitments.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in Canada. If you're in Vancouver, we’d love to get together for the occasional coffee or tea, meal, or working session.
  • Real-world impact: You aren’t just moving tickets; you’re contributing to building digital infrastructure that helps Canadian communities thrive.
  • Inclusive in every way: We value diversity in all forms: cultures, ages, sexualities, gender identities, neurotypes, and life experiences. We believe that a team with a wide range of thoughts and perspectives builds better products for the diverse communities we serve. We all contribute to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and empowered to bring their whole, authentic self to work. We particularly encourage women and members of other underrepresented groups in tech to apply.
  • No drama and no tech-bro culture: We hire for potential and ‘good human’ vibes. We treat everyone as autonomous professionals where we value collaboration when it’s needed, but we also trust you to simply get on with your work. Our culture is built on mutual respect for the unique skills each person brings to the table.

Hiring Timeline and Rate

We are looking to hire quickly, therefore this posting will be taken down around 5pm PT on Sun September 13, 2026. We plan to run interviews the week of September 14, and make an offer asap for a preferred start date of October 1, 2026.

We are hiring a part-time term employee for an initial period of 6 months. This position may be extended and/or turned into a permanent role depending on how our company grows and in your interest in continuing to work with us.

You will work part-time of 20 hours per week within our typical team schedule of Mon-Thurs, anywhere between 9am-7pm PT. If you are working outside BC, we need the majority of your daily hours to overlap with our team time. You can choose which hours within that window work best for you (although with our input due to team meetings etc), and some hours outside the core window are also doable.

We are a fully remote team working within Canada (sorry, candidates physically located outside of Canada will not be considered).

Our budget for this role is within the $32/hr to $40/hr range, depending on your skills and strength of your experience.

How to Get Our Attention

If you’ve managed to read this far, then chances are you’d love working here (and you appreciate more detail over less!). So as a bonus, we wanted to share some tips with you when applying, because yes, our CEO, Briana Sim (LinkedIn), reads every application. To move to the top of the pile:

  1. Show your style: In your summary or cover note, tell us why our mission resonates with you. If you have built a workflow or managed a project you are proud of, tell us about it. We would also love to hear what keeps you curious outside of work, whether it is a passion project or your ideal Friday off.
  2. Give us the real resume: We prefer longer, chronological resumes, and career changes or gaps are fine by us (life is often life-ing, right?). We value context and honesty. We want to understand what you actually accomplished, what you learned, how you performed both individually and as a collaborator, and how your experience makes you ready to grow with us.
    • Please also make sure to clearly indicate your role, start and end dates (month + year), company name, location (City/Province if in Canada; or City/Country if abroad – and yes we do hire folks with international experience outside of Canada), and your education including the same dates and location format as with roles.

--

FYI SimpliCity was spun out from our sister company Radical I/O in 2022. While we operate as a dedicated startup team focused on our composable CMS platform, we share a centralized recruitment platform (and founding team) with Radical I/O.

CompassX is partnering with an enterprise client to support a fast-moving AI-driven initiative connecting their Oracle E-Business Suite environment to a broader integration and applications ecosystem. This is a chance to work at the architecture and development level on a genuinely complex problem for an organization that's investing seriously in modernizing how its core ERP talks to the rest of its new applications and technology stack.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build a common data-services layer that connects multiple, differently-configured Oracle EBS instances across regions — reconciling real differences between environments rather than treating them as identical
  • Expose EBS data through integrations and APIs to other systems, with a particular focus on Manufacturing, Inventory, and Item Master data
  • Work hands-on with PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces, and standard APIs — this is a build role, not a configuration role
  • Partner directly with other developers and technical stakeholders as a peer — you'll be the one they come to with questions about the SQL and architecture, not someone translating between business and engineering
  • Bring an architect's perspective to the work: looking across distinct systems, spotting where approaches diverge, and designing a solution that holds up across all of them rather than solving for just one environment
  • Act as a trusted technical voice in a still-evolving initiative — this program is actively taking shape, and there's real room to help define how the work gets scoped and delivered, not just execute against a fixed spec

What You'll Bring

  • Strong experience working as a true consultant to your stakeholders and clients
  • Deep, hands-on Oracle EBS technical development experience - strong PL/SQL, EBS Open Interfaces and standard APIs, and concurrent program load mechanisms
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and/or SOA, plus REST/SOAP web services
  • Working knowledge of EBS data models for Manufacturing/BOM, Inventory, and Item Master — direct experience with the Item/PTM table is especially valuable
  • Experience working across multiple EBS instances, ideally having reconciled differently-configured environments
  • A technical/integration mindset over a functional/configuration one - comfortable going deep on code and architecture, not just gathering requirements
  • Comfort operating with some ambiguity - this is an early-stage initiative, and part of the value you bring is helping shape the approach alongside the team, not just following one that's already fully defined
  • Bonus if familiarity with Oracle PD Cloud (Oracle PLM)
Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.
With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.
At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

Job Title: Software Engineer, Data Platforms

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

This is an AI-native fullstack engineering role building micro1's human data platforms. You'll own features end-to-end, from backend services and data pipelines to the frontends our experts use every day.

The role sits between traditional fullstack and research engineering. Coding agents are your primary development workflow, and you'll work closely with research engineers, operations, and product to turn requirements into reliable production systems.

What You'll Own

  1. Design and ship fullstack features across backend APIs, data pipelines, and React frontends.
  2. Own client-facing data delivery and platform infrastructure, including exports, access control, and reliability.
  3. Scope work around outcomes, direct coding agents—often in parallel—review changes at the architecture level, and iterate until shipped.
  4. Build and maintain services in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript.
  5. Contribute to data modeling, schema design, and query performance across relational and document databases.
  6. Partner with research engineering, operations, and product to translate platform needs into production-ready systems.
  7. Improve the frameworks, checks, and evals that make agent-driven development faster without sacrificing quality.
  8. Troubleshoot production issues and build resilient, observable systems.

What We're Looking For

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  2. 0–5 years of software engineering experience, or strong shipped projects as a recent graduate.
  3. Strong fundamentals in Python and TypeScript, with experience building CRUD applications using frameworks such as FastAPI/Flask and React.
  4. Working knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite and core data modeling principles.
  5. Experience deploying services on a major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  6. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex are your default development workflow, and you can clearly explain how you use them.
  7. Ability to turn outcomes into plans, direct agents, verify results, and identify architectural issues agents may miss.
  8. Understanding of agent loops, MCP, tool/data integrations, permissions, and security.
  9. Familiarity with context management, RAG, and evals for testing agent workflows.

Preferred

  1. Exposure to RL concepts or environments, including tasks, actions, and rewards.
  2. Experience with coding data pipelines or task-authoring platforms.
  3. Familiarity with CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and DevOps fundamentals.
  4. Experience contributing to team projects, open-source software, or startups.

The national pay range for this full-time position is a base salary of $120,000 - $160,000 per year. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
