Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the role :

    HighLevel is hiring a Director of Product Pricing & Monetization to lead our company-wide approach to pricing, packaging, monetization, and customer research.

    This person will help HighLevel answer four critical questions:

  • Who are our most important customer segments, and what outcomes are they trying to achieve?

  • Which products, capabilities, and services do those customers value most?

  • How should we package and price our offerings to align customer value with sustainable company growth?

  • How do we create a continuous customer-learning system that improves product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions?

    • You will sit at the intersection of Product, Finance, Data, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Operations. You will combine customer research, behavioral data, market intelligence, financial analysis, and experimentation to shape HighLevel’s commercial strategy.

    This is not an advisory-only role. You will be expected to develop recommendations, build alignment, support implementation, measure results, and improve decisions based on what we learn.

    The role reports to the Chief of Staff and will have significant exposure to HighLevel’s executive leadership team.

What you will own

    Pricing and packaging strategy

  • Develop a clear, company-wide pricing and packaging strategy across subscription plans, product bundles, add-ons, usage-based capabilities, services, and new product launches.

  • Evaluate how HighLevel’s pricing architecture should evolve as the platform expands into new products, customer segments, and monetization models.

  • Identify the most appropriate value metrics for different parts of the platform, including where subscription, usage-based, account-based, feature-based, or hybrid pricing models may be appropriate.

  • Assess opportunities to improve plan differentiation, feature entitlements, upgrade paths, product bundling, and add-on attachment.

  • Build business cases for pricing and packaging changes, including expected impact on acquisition, trial-to-paid conversion, average revenue per customer, expansion, retention, gross margin, and lifetime value.

  • Develop principles and guardrails for discounts, promotions, trials, grandfathering, migrations, and price increases.

  • Partner with Finance and Data teams to model revenue impact, customer impact, adoption scenarios, and potential risks.

  • Create a prioritized monetization roadmap rather than treating pricing as a series of isolated decisions.

    • Customer research and insights

  • Build a continuous customer research program covering prospects, trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agency owners, affiliates, and the businesses operating within agency sub-accounts.

  • Establish a clear segmentation framework based on customer needs, behaviors, maturity, business models, use cases, value realization, and willingness to pay.

  • Lead qualitative and quantitative research, including customer interviews, surveys, concept testing, win/loss analysis, churn research, behavioral analysis, and willingness-to-pay studies.

  • Understand the jobs customers hire HighLevel to perform, the outcomes they value, the alternatives they consider, and the barriers that prevent them from adopting or expanding.

  • Create a centralized customer-insights repository so that research is accessible, reusable, and connected to company decisions.

  • Develop a regular cadence for sharing insights with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.

  • Translate research into clear implications for product strategy, roadmap prioritization, positioning, onboarding, customer education, and go-to-market execution.

    • Experimentation and implementation

  • Design pricing, packaging, positioning, and offer experiments with clearly defined hypotheses, target segments, success metrics, and decision criteria.

  • Partner with Product, Growth, Engineering, Billing, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to operationalize approved changes.

  • Develop rollout strategies that account for existing customers, new customers, channel partners, affiliates, billing complexity, communications, and customer support.

  • Establish guardrails to ensure that monetization initiatives improve business performance without creating unacceptable deterioration in customer trust, conversion, adoption, or retention.

  • Build post-launch measurement plans and ensure that each major pricing or packaging decision generates reusable learning.

  • Monitor performance across metrics such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, add-on attachment, expansion, downgrade rates, churn, net revenue retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

    • Market and competitive intelligence

  • Maintain a structured view of pricing, packaging, positioning, and monetization trends across relevant SaaS, agency technology, CRM, marketing automation, communications, AI, and adjacent software categories.

  • Identify changes in customer expectations, competitive offers, business models, and emerging value metrics.

  • Distinguish between competitive signals that require action and those that should not influence HighLevel’s strategy.

  • Use market intelligence as one input alongside customer value, product strategy, economics, and HighLevel’s long-term differentiation.

    • Decision-making and organizational leadership

  • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization operating cadence, including clear decision rights, approval processes, and measurement standards.

  • Bring structure to complex decisions where customer needs, product strategy, technical constraints, and financial outcomes may conflict.

  • Present recommendations to senior leaders in a clear, commercially grounded, and decision-oriented manner.

  • Build alignment across functions while remaining willing to challenge assumptions and surface difficult trade-offs.

  • Initially operate as a hands-on leader and, as the function develops, help define and build the right team across pricing, monetization analytics, and customer insights.

  • Raise the organization’s overall capability in customer research, pricing strategy, experimentation, and value-based decision-making.

What we are looking for

  • 12+ years of experience across SaaS pricing, monetization, product strategy, customer insights, growth strategy, management consulting, corporate strategy, or related roles.

  • Significant direct experience leading pricing and packaging decisions for a B2B SaaS, platform, or technology company.

  • Demonstrated experience translating customer research and data into changes in product, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategy.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, including subscription economics, usage-based pricing, expansion revenue, retention, gross margin, and customer lifetime value.

  • Experience working with multi-product or multi-tier offerings and navigating the impact of pricing changes on existing and new customers.

  • Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills, with the ability to develop scenarios, challenge assumptions, and make recommendations with imperfect information.

  • Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, such as customer interviews, segmentation, surveys, willingness-to-pay analysis, concept testing, conjoint analysis, and behavioral data analysis.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer value, growth, simplicity, operational feasibility, and long-term strategy.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation and decision.

  • A highly collaborative working style and a record of influencing Product, Finance, Data, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success leaders.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the operating model and analytical foundation may still need to be built.

  • A player-coach mentality: equally comfortable defining strategy, conducting customer interviews, reviewing analyses, building a business case, and supporting execution.

Preferred experience

  • Experience with product-led growth, free trials, self-serve acquisition, or hybrid product-led and sales-assisted models.

  • Experience with agency software, SMB software, CRM, marketing automation, communications, payments, AI products, or vertical SaaS.

  • Experience with ecosystems in which the direct customer serves or resells products to another end customer.

  • Experience with white-label products, reseller models, marketplaces, channel partners, or multi-sided platforms.

  • Experience launching usage-based products or monetizing high-variable-cost capabilities such as communications, payments, infrastructure, or AI.

  • Familiarity with SQL, experimentation platforms, business intelligence tools, or product analytics systems.

  • Experience building a pricing, customer insights, or monetization function from an early stage

What success looks like

    In the first 90 days

  • Develop a clear understanding of HighLevel’s customer segments, current plans, product entitlements, monetization model, customer economics, and decision-making processes.

  • Complete an initial assessment of pricing and packaging opportunities, risks, customer pain points, and analytical gaps.

  • Establish a customer research agenda across trial users, paying customers, expanded customers, churned customers, agencies, affiliates, and sub-accounts.

  • Create an initial pricing and packaging opportunity backlog, distinguishing near-term improvements from longer-term strategic questions.

  • Establish a cross-functional pricing and monetization governance process.

    • Within six months

  • Deliver a practical customer segmentation and needs framework that is actively used by Product and go-to-market teams.

  • Establish a repeatable customer research and insight-sharing cadence.

  • Present a prioritized pricing and packaging roadmap supported by customer evidence, behavioral data, competitive context, and financial modeling.

  • Launch or support the launch of the first major pricing, packaging, or monetization initiative.

  • Implement reporting that connects pricing decisions to customer and business outcomes.

    • Within the first year

  • Establish a clear and scalable pricing architecture across HighLevel’s core platform, add-ons, and emerging products.

  • Build a trusted customer-insights capability that consistently informs product, go-to-market, and strategic decisions.

  • Create a repeatable process for researching, testing, launching, and evaluating monetization changes.

  • Deliver measurable improvement across one or more key outcomes, such as trial-to-paid conversion, plan mix, average revenue per customer, product attachment, expansion, retention, net revenue retention, or gross margin.

  • Build strong organizational confidence that major pricing and product decisions are grounded in customer value, sound economics, and rigorous learning.

Why this role matters

    HighLevel’s pricing and packaging decisions influence far more than revenue. They shape which customers we attract, how quickly customers understand the platform, which products they adopt, how agencies build businesses on top of HighLevel, and how effectively we can continue investing in customer value.

    This role will help create the customer understanding and commercial discipline required for HighLevel’s next stage of growth.

    The salary range for this position is $207000 - $269000 annually.

This role owns the build-out of Portnox's account-based marketing (ABM) motion — an end-to-end demand creation framework, tightly aligned with the SDR team, that drives awareness, consideration, and demand across a defined set of target accounts and the contacts within their buying committees. You'll have latitude to define the channel mix — content, display, social, email, and events — but every campaign should be treated as an always-on motion that evolves over time and connects back to specific contacts within named target accounts, not a one-off push.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Motion Design
  • Design and build a repeatable ABM campaign framework spanning content syndication, display/programmatic, paid social, email, and event channels
  • Define messaging and asset requirements by segment and persona so campaigns speak directly to each role within a target account's buying committee
  • Treat every campaign as an always-on motion, continuously refreshing with new content, assets, webinars, and other engagement opportunities

Channel Execution
  • Manage always-on content syndication programs refreshing targeting and creative on a regular cadence to generate engaged contacts within target accounts
  • Own account-based display/programmatic advertising through an ABM or intent-data platform (e.g., 6sense), refreshing target account lists regularly and optimizing for message relevance and opportunity creation
  • Manage paid social campaigns (e.g., LinkedIn) targeted at buying committee contacts within named accounts
  • Own intent-triggered email programs across marketing automation and ABM platforms, and partner with SDRs on their sales engagement sequences
  • Align with SDR-led outreach so messaging and timing stay consistent with the broader campaign
  • Help plan and execute high-touch account engagement events (e.g., executive dinners and roundtables) for priority accounts

Sales & SDR Alignment
  • Lead regular campaign execution meetings with the SDR team to align on target accounts, messaging, timing, and follow-up
  • Serve as the connective tissue between marketing programs and SDR outreach so every touch feels coordinated rather than siloed

Reporting & Analytics
  • Build reporting that shows account-level movement: engagement, intent-signal progression, and stage advancement through the funnel
  • Report against the core goal of opportunity creation within defined target accounts tying activity across every channel back to pipeline outcomes

What Success Looks Like
  • Consistent opportunity creation within defined target accounts
  • A repeatable, documented ABM playbook that scales beyond any single campaign
  • Regular working alignment with the SDR team, with clear shared visibility into target account status
  • Reporting that shows account engagement and progression, not just individual lead activity

Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

  • 4-6+ years in B2B demand generation or account-based marketing, ideally having built or scaled an ABM program from the ground up
  • Hands-on experience with an ABM/intent platform (e.g., 6sense) and content syndication vendors (e.g., TechTarget, BrightTalk)
  • Experience running paid social campaigns targeted at named accounts (e.g., LinkedIn)
  • Experience with a marketing automation platform and a sales engagement tool (e.g., Outreach)
  • Experience with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and account-level reporting/analytics tools
  • A track record of partnering closely with SDR/BDR teams — comfortable leading recurring working sessions and holding channels accountable to shared account goals
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, with experience building account-level (not just lead-level) dashboards
  • A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to be hands-on and build programs from scratch
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.description:
The Second Nature Story

The Challenge

Obesity has become a global epidemic; in the UK, we spend £9 billion a year alone on diseases like type 2 diabetes (that's 10% of the NHS budget). What's shocking is most of this is preventable - through sustained lifestyle and habit change.

Enter Second Nature.

We're here to help people take control of their health. By bringing together behavioural science, technology, and incredible people, our grand mission is to eradicate the global epidemic of chronic lifestyle diseases once and for all.

About Us

  • We've positively changed the lives of 300,000+ people through accessible, evidence-based healthcare.
  • We're rated 'Excellent' on Trustpilot by over 8,000 of our members.
  • We're the UK’s largest digital health provider to the NHS
  • We're a leading B2C provider of GLP-1 medication-assisted weight loss programmes, and 1 of 5 NICE-approved providers to deliver these services within the NHS in the future
  • Our team members stay with us for an average of 4.3 years

The Role

We're bringing more of our prescribing in-house. This role is about doing that well for our private and Medication Supported Programme (MSP) clients - the more straightforward end of our caseload, where Second Nature is the responsible prescribing organisation.

You'll run remote prescribing reviews for private clients on our weight management programme: assessing suitability, prescribing within a defined formulary, and monitoring people safely through their journey. It's focused clinical work with a clear pathway, good support around you, and a weekly MDT to bring cases and questions to.

What You'll Do

  • Carry out remote prescribing reviews and consultations (video, telephone and asynchronous) for private/MSP clients, assessing eligibility and suitability against the medicine's licence and our criteria.
  • Confirm identity and weight verification is complete and accurate before prescribing, and cross-check medication history against the Summary Care Record or GP record where available.
  • Lead shared decision-making - set out benefits, risks and alternatives, confirm capacity and consent (including consent to notify the GP), and document it fully in the clinical record.
  • Prescribe within your licence and competence and within the agreed formulary (Wegovy, Mounjaro, Saxenda, Orlistat), following GMC good and remote prescribing standards and the RPS Prescribing Competency Framework.
  • Manage the prescribing journey through to dispensing, GP notification, follow-up and titration, repeats, monitoring and discharge - tracking each step in our clinical system so nothing is missed.
  • Handle side effects, adherence and dosage queries, and recognise when something needs more than a straightforward review - escalating promptly to the Clinicial Lead where necessary.
  • Bring complex or interesting cases, protocol questions and improvement ideas to the monthly MDT, and act on what's agreed.
  • Keep accurate, contemporaneous clinical records, and contribute to prescribing audits, incident reporting and duty of candour where required.

Requirements

Who You Are

Need to Haves

  • A current, unrestricted UK prescribing registration: a GMC-registered doctor or a GPhC-registered pharmacist or NMC-registered nurse holding an independent prescriber qualification.
  • Confident, safe remote prescriber, working comfortably within GMC good and remote prescribing standards and the RPS competency framework.
  • Experience in assessing patients for and prescribing GLP-1 therapies and other weight management medications.
  • Sound clinical judgement about your own scope - prescribe within your competence and escalate early when in doubt.
  • Clear, careful clinical documentation and strong follow-through on the operational steps that keep a client's journey safe.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Comfortable working digital-first, across the systems that run the pathway.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in diabetes or metabolic health.
  • Experience prescribing in a private or digital health setting.
  • An interest in service improvement - helping us sharpen protocols and pathways as we grow in-house prescribing.

Role-Specific Notes

  • Remote, UK-based. You must be UK-based and hold current UK professional registration and revalidation.
  • Scope is private / MSP in-house prescribing only. This role does not cover NHS Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS) prescribing, Right to Choose, or BSOP / prescribing-partner arrangements.
  • 20-40 hours per week, split evenly across 5 days and the ability to undertake weekend work, if required.
  • Initial fixed term contract, with the potential to transition to a permanent contract based on performance.

Benefits

What You Get

  • An exciting opportunity to work in one of the UK's most innovative health tech start-ups
  • See the real-world impact of your work, helping thousands of people improve their health and wellbeing
  • Flexible working hours and autonomy to support your wellbeing
  • 100% remote working from anywhere in the UK
  • A named Clinical Lead, a clear escalation pathway and a monthly MDT for support
  • A supportive, mission-driven team passionate about transforming public health

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — UK (Intermediate to Senior
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure.

This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams.

We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working.

Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United Kingdom only. Candidates based in the United States or Canada can apply to this posting:Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — AMER (Intermediate to Senior Staff)

How our SRE hiring works

Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team.

  • Recruiter Screen: A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction.
  • Core Technical: The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab.
  • Peer Technical: Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on.
  • Skip-Level Interview: A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams.

After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

We’ll calibrate your level throughout the interview process based on the scope and impact of your experience.

  • Intermediate: You independently deliver meaningful reliability improvements within a defined area.
  • Senior: You own complex reliability work end to end and raise the effectiveness of your team.
  • Staff: You shape reliability across multiple teams, solving systemic problems and creating approaches others can reuse.
  • Senior Staff: You set technical direction across a broader Infrastructure area and influence reliability strategy at organizational scale.

What you'll do

  • Keep user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient
  • Build automation and tooling that reduces toil and replaces manual work with repeatable, infrastructure-as-code-driven workflows
  • Operate and troubleshoot production systems on Kubernetes, including deployments, rollouts, and scaling
  • Write and maintain infrastructure as code, and ship changes safely through CI/CD and GitOps
  • Participate in on-call, triage alerts, follow and improve runbooks, and escalate appropriately
  • Contribute to the observability stack, using metrics, logs, and SLOs to detect symptoms early rather than just outages
  • Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews, turning learnings into changes in automation and process
  • Document runbooks, architecture decisions, and reviews so your findings become repeatable practices

What you'll bring

  • Experience keeping production systems reliable, combining an operations mindset with real software engineering practice
  • Experience building net-new infrastructure tooling and automation, not just configuring existing tools. For example, Terraform modules, Kubernetes operators or controllers, or production automation and services written from scratch
  • The ability to read, debug, and reason about code. Most of our teams work in Go; some work in Ruby. You can discuss a piece of code's behavior, performance, and failure modes
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, and with Kubernetes and its ecosystem, at a depth appropriate to your level
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (GCP or AWS)
  • Familiarity with observability practices, including metrics, logging, alerting, and SLOs or SLIs, and using data to inform operational decisions
  • Comfort participating in on-call and incident response, with a structured approach to troubleshooting under pressure
  • Strong written communication and the ability to operate as a manager-of-one in an async, distributed environment
  • A track record of using automation, and increasingly AI, to reduce toil and improve how you and your team work
  • Alignment with GitLab's values and a commitment to working in accordance with them

About the team

Infrastructure Platforms is responsible for the availability, reliability, performance, and scalability of GitLab’s user-facing services, most notably GitLab.com. The organization spans teams across Production Engineering, GitLab Dedicated, GitLab Delivery, and Developer Experience, covering everything from the production fleet and networking platform to observability, incident response, deployment infrastructure, tenant scale, and our single-tenant Dedicated offering.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first organization that works asynchronously, favors automation over toil, and uses monitoring, metrics, and clear ownership to continuously improve the reliability of GitLab at scale. For more on how we work, see the Infrastructure Handbook Page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring an Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable Specialist for one of our clients to support day-to-day accounting operations and ensure incoming and outgoing financial transactions are processed accurately and on time.

You’ll take ownership of vendor invoices, customer billing, collections, payments, reconciliations, and financial documentation, helping maintain healthy cash flow and clean accounting records.

This role is ideal for someone who is highly detail-oriented, organized, comfortable working with high transaction volumes, and proactive about resolving discrepancies before they become larger issues.

What You’ll Own

Accounts Payable (AP)

  • Review, code, and process vendor invoices accurately and on time.
  • Enter invoices into accounting systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero, SAP, or similar platforms.
  • Schedule and coordinate payments through ACH, wire transfers, checks, or online payment systems.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and investigate discrepancies.
  • Process employee reimbursements and corporate credit card transactions.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure payments are completed according to agreed terms.

Accounts Receivable (AR)

  • Generate and distribute customer invoices accurately and on schedule.
  • Record customer payments and reconcile incoming transactions.
  • Monitor AR aging reports and identify overdue accounts.
  • Follow up professionally with customers regarding outstanding balances.
  • Respond to billing questions and help resolve invoice disputes.
  • Support collections and payment arrangements when required.
  • Track deferred or unearned revenue balances where applicable.

Reconciliations & Month-End Support

  • Reconcile AR and AP subledgers with the general ledger.
  • Match cash receipts and disbursements against bank activity.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences.
  • Assist with month-end close and accrual-related activities.
  • Prepare weekly cash collection and disbursement reports.
  • Ensure financial transactions are properly recorded and supported.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate vendor and customer records, including W-9s, contracts, and payment terms.
  • Keep financial documentation organized and audit-ready.
  • Follow established internal controls and accounting procedures.
  • Support accounting practices aligned with GAAP/IFRS requirements.
  • Assist finance leadership with audit and reporting requests.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work with finance, sales, procurement, and operations teams to resolve billing and payment issues.
  • Communicate professionally with vendors and customers.
  • Investigate discrepancies and coordinate resolution across stakeholders.
  • Help improve AR/AP workflows and documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve accounting efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re highly detail-oriented and accuracy matters to you.
  • You can manage large volumes of invoices and transactions without losing track of details.
  • You’re comfortable following up on overdue payments professionally.
  • You can identify and resolve reconciliation discrepancies independently.
  • You communicate confidently with vendors, customers, and internal teams.
  • You balance speed with accuracy and compliance.
  • You take ownership of issues through resolution.
  • You work effectively in a remote accounting environment with minimal supervision.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, bookkeeping, or accounting operations.
  • Hands-on experience with accounting software such as:
    • QuickBooks
    • NetSuite
    • Xero
    • SAP
    • Similar accounting/ERP platforms
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • VLOOKUP
    • Pivot Tables
    • Reconciliation workflows
  • Experience processing vendor invoices and payments.
  • Experience generating customer invoices and following up on collections.
  • Understanding of AR/AP reconciliation processes.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational ability.
  • Ability to work aligned with U.S. business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-currency AR/AP experience.
  • Experience with Bill.com, Tipalti, or similar AP/AR automation platforms.
  • Familiarity with GAAP or IFRS accounting practices.
  • Experience supporting month-end close.
  • Experience in SaaS, professional services, real estate, manufacturing, or e-commerce.
  • Experience supporting ERP migrations or accounting process improvements.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing and processing new vendor invoices.
  • Recording customer payments.
  • Checking AR aging reports and following up on overdue accounts.
  • Scheduling upcoming vendor payments.
  • Reconciling vendor statements and accounting records.
  • Investigating discrepancies between transactions and bank activity.
  • Responding to vendor or customer billing questions.
  • Updating accounting records and supporting documentation.
  • Preparing cash collection and disbursement reports.
  • Supporting the finance team with month-end close activities.

In short: you help ensure money coming in and going out is tracked accurately, processed on time, and properly documented.

What Success Looks Like

  • Vendor and customer invoices processed accurately with minimal errors.
  • AP payments completed within agreed payment terms.
  • Reduced overdue AR balances and improved collection cycles.
  • Accurate and timely account reconciliations.
  • Reliable support during month-end close.
  • Clean, complete, and audit-ready financial documentation.
  • Fast resolution of billing and payment discrepancies.
  • Strong relationships with vendors, customers, and internal stakeholders.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Hands-on ownership across both Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable.
  • Exposure to end-to-end accounting operations.
  • Opportunity to work with U.S.-based businesses and accounting teams.
  • Experience with leading accounting and ERP platforms.
  • Opportunity to improve financial processes and automation.
  • Fully remote working environment.
  • Growth potential into Senior AR/AP Specialist, Staff Accountant, Accounting Operations, or Finance Operations roles.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment — AP/AR Reconciliation or Aging Report Exercise
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and let your story carry forward. Hiring managers can see how you communicate before meeting you, making future interviews more focused and meaningful.

You can record your video as many times as you like before submitting it — only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced AR/AP professional who is detail-oriented, comfortable with reconciliations, and confident managing invoices, payments, and collections, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help keep financial operations accurate, organized, and running smoothly.

jobs.title: Masonry Shop Architect
jobs.excerpt: Position Summary The Masonry Shop Drawing Architect / Designer is responsible for producing accurate, detailed, and construction-ready masonry shop drawings for commercial construction projects.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Masonry Shop Drawing Architect / Designer is responsible for producing accurate, detailed, and construction-ready masonry shop drawings for commercial construction projects. Working directly for a masonry contractor, this position translates architectural and structural construction documents into detailed masonry drawings that can be used for fabrication, installation, coordination, and project approval.

The position requires a strong understanding of masonry construction, architectural detailing, structural requirements, building codes, and construction documents. The ideal candidate will be able to identify conflicts and constructability issues before they reach the field and work closely with project managers, estimators, superintendents, general contractors, architects, engineers, and subcontractors to develop practical masonry solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Masonry Shop Drawings

  • Prepare detailed masonry shop drawings for commercial construction projects.
  • Develop plans, elevations, sections, details, and enlarged views necessary for masonry installation.
  • Detail CMU, brick, stone, veneer, reinforced masonry, and other masonry systems.
  • Prepare drawings showing masonry coursing, wall types, openings, control joints, expansion joints, reinforcing, embeds, flashing, shelf angles, lintels, and other masonry components.
  • Develop detailed layouts for masonry walls, partitions, elevations, and exterior façade systems.
  • Incorporate architectural and structural requirements into masonry shop drawings.
  • Ensure drawings accurately reflect project specifications, architectural details, structural drawings, and approved design requirements.
  • Prepare drawings suitable for submission to the general contractor, architect, and engineer for review and approval.

Drawing Review & Coordination

  • Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings to identify conditions that affect masonry construction.
  • Coordinate masonry work with structural steel, concrete, precast, storefront, curtain wall, windows, doors, roofing, waterproofing, and other building systems.
  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential conflicts between architectural and structural documents.
  • Review dimensions, elevations, wall locations, openings, and structural support conditions.
  • Coordinate masonry openings and penetrations with other trades.
  • Identify constructability issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Maintain awareness of the latest drawing revisions and incorporate approved changes into shop drawings.

Architectural & Structural Detailing

  • Interpret architectural plans, elevations, sections, wall sections, and details.
  • Interpret structural drawings and identify requirements affecting masonry installation.
  • Detail masonry reinforcement, lintels, bond beams, grouted cells, anchors, ties, embeds, and structural connections.
  • Detail flashing, weeps, drainage cavities, waterproofing interfaces, and moisture-management components.
  • Coordinate shelf angles, relieving angles, embeds, and other structural support systems.
  • Ensure masonry details comply with project specifications and applicable building codes and standards.

Shop Drawing Submittals

  • Prepare complete masonry shop drawing packages for review and approval.
  • Coordinate shop drawings with project specifications and contract requirements.
  • Incorporate architect, engineer, and general contractor comments into revised drawings.
  • Maintain revision histories and drawing logs.
  • Track drawing status from initial preparation through approval.
  • Respond to review comments and issue revised drawings in a timely manner.
  • Maintain organized electronic records of current and superseded drawings.

Field & Project Support

  • Work with project managers and field superintendents to resolve masonry-related questions and field conditions.
  • Review field conditions when required and revise drawings to reflect approved changes.
  • Assist with resolving conflicts between masonry installation and other trades.
  • Provide technical support to field personnel regarding shop drawings and masonry details.
  • Assist with RFI preparation when contract documents do not provide sufficient information.
  • Participate in project coordination meetings when architectural or masonry detailing issues need to be addressed.
  • Assist project teams with interpreting approved shop drawings during construction.

Design Changes & Coordination

  • Review revised architectural and structural drawings for impacts to masonry scope.
  • Update shop drawings to reflect approved design changes.
  • Identify changes that may affect quantities, labor, materials, sequencing, or constructability.
  • Communicate significant design changes to project management.
  • Assist with documenting changes for potential change orders when requested.

Quality Control

  • Perform thorough quality-control reviews of shop drawings before submission.
  • Verify dimensions, elevations, wall locations, openings, details, and references.
  • Confirm consistency between plans, elevations, sections, and details.
  • Verify that drawings accurately represent the intended masonry installation.
  • Ensure drawings follow company drafting standards and project-specific requirements.
  • Review drawings for coordination with other trades before release.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Architectural Technology, Engineering, Construction Technology, or a related field is preferred.
  • 3–7 years of experience producing architectural, structural, or masonry shop drawings.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial masonry construction.
  • Experience detailing CMU, brick, stone, veneer, and reinforced masonry systems.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD is required.
  • Experience with Revit or other BIM software is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of architectural and structural detailing.
  • Working knowledge of masonry construction practices, materials, and installation methods.
  • Strong knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, and project documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Architectural license or architectural registration is a plus but not required.
  • Experience working directly for a masonry contractor is strongly preferred.
  • Experience producing masonry shop drawings for commercial construction projects.
  • Familiarity with CMU, brick veneer, adhered and anchored stone, cast stone, thin brick, and other masonry systems.
  • Knowledge of TMS 402/602, applicable building codes, and masonry industry standards.
  • Experience with structural masonry and reinforcing requirements.
  • Experience coordinating with structural steel, concrete, precast, curtain wall, storefront, and waterproofing systems.
  • Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bluebeam, or similar construction management/document-control software.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent architectural drafting and detailing skills.
  • Strong understanding of masonry construction and installation.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong spatial and technical reasoning skills.
  • Ability to visualize construction conditions in three dimensions.
  • Ability to identify conflicts before they become field issues.
  • Strong understanding of architectural and structural coordination.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shop drawing packages and project deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project managers, superintendents, estimators, architects, engineers, general contractors, and other trades.
  • Ability to work independently while meeting strict project deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Typical Deliverables

The Masonry Shop Drawing Architect / Designer may be responsible for producing:

  • Masonry floor plans
  • Masonry elevations
  • Wall sections
  • Enlarged masonry details
  • Typical masonry details
  • CMU wall layouts
  • Brick veneer layouts
  • Stone veneer layouts
  • Masonry coursing diagrams
  • Lintel details
  • Shelf-angle details
  • Reinforcing details
  • Bond beam details
  • Control and expansion joint details
  • Flashing and weep details
  • Anchoring and tie details
  • Window and door opening details
  • Parapet and roof-interface details
  • Masonry-to-structure connection details
  • Masonry-to-curtain-wall/storefront details
  • Penetration and miscellaneous opening details
  • As-built or record drawings when required

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office-based with regular interaction with active construction projects.
  • Occasional visits to construction sites may be required to verify field conditions and assist with coordination.
  • Appropriate PPE is required when visiting active construction sites.
  • May require occasional travel to project sites and coordination meetings.
  • Position may require working extended hours to meet critical project submittal deadlines.

Performance Measures

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Accuracy and completeness of masonry shop drawings.
  • Timely submission and approval of shop drawings.
  • Reduction of field conflicts, rework, and installation issues.
  • Effective coordination with architectural, structural, and other trade drawings.
  • Accuracy of masonry dimensions, elevations, openings, and details.
  • Responsiveness to architect, engineer, and general contractor comments.
  • Ability to meet project submittal schedules.
  • Quality and consistency of drafting and detailing.
  • Effective support of project managers and field personnel.
  • Contribution to successful project completion.

Requirements

This is a full time role

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to take on the most senior individual-contributor role within our Infrastructure team. Working alongside the VP of Infrastructure, you will help set technical direction, architecture and engineering standards while remaining deeply involved in solving complex technical challenges.

This is a cloud-agnostic role with a strong current emphasis on Microsoft Azure. You will play a leading role in establishing and maturing our Azure platform while also working across our existing AWS environment. You will drive modern cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, observability, CI/CD and automation, combining strong architectural judgement with hands-on engineering capability.

Requirements

What you will be doing

  • Azure cloud architecture: Lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable and highly available Azure infrastructure, including Landing Zone architecture, governance, networking, identity, security guardrails and reusable infrastructure patterns.

  • CI/CD & GitOps: Design and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines using technologies such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins, integrating IaC, version control, automated testing, policy enforcement and deployment automation.

  • Observability: Build and improve monitoring and observability using technologies such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Cortex, Loki and Azure-native observability services, including dashboards, monitors, alerting and integrations.

  • Automation & scripting: Use Python and automation to reduce repetitive operational work, integrate infrastructure tooling and improve reliability. Review automation code and provide technical direction on how infrastructure automation should be structured.

  • Platform engineering: Build reusable infrastructure capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision, deploy and operate applications efficiently with less manual dependency on Infrastructure.

  • Reliability & security: Engineer for high availability, disaster recovery and production resilience while embedding strong cloud security, IAM, networking, access controls and security guardrails into infrastructure design.

  • Technical leadership: Mentor infrastructure engineers through hands-on collaboration, technical and design reviews and knowledge sharing, raising engineering capability while remaining an individual contributor.

  • Cross-functional engineering: Work closely with Software Engineering, Security and other technical teams to understand requirements and design appropriate infrastructure solutions.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Microsoft Azure: Strong hands-on Azure infrastructure architecture, implementation and operational experience. You should be comfortable designing and establishing Azure environments rather than only administering existing services. Azure Landing Zone, governance, networking, identity and security experience is particularly relevant.

  • Terraform: Advanced hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, multi-environment infrastructure, testing and scalable IaC patterns.

jobs.description:
The Licensed Behavior Analyst (LBA) Recruiter is a specialized Human Resources professional responsible for sourcing, recruiting, and hiring qualified Licensed Behavior Analysts to support ABA therapy service delivery. This role goes beyond traditional recruitment; the LBA Recruiter serves as the primary HR partner, managing the full LBA lifecycle, from initial sourcing through credentialing, facilitation of Medicaid partnerships, and ongoing accreditation maintenance.

The LBA Recruiter works closely with BCBAs seeking LBA licensure, guides them through the accreditation process in partnership with LTE Care Plus, and ensures that all active LBAs maintain current credentials and Medicaid enrollment. This role requires a strong understanding of ABA licensure requirements in New York, Medicaid provider enrollment processes, and HRIS administration. The LBA Recruiter reports directly to the HR Director.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

LBA Sourcing, Recruitment & Hiring

  • Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies to identify and attract qualified Licensed Behavior Analysts across NYC, Long Island, and Westchester County
  • Post and manage LBA job listings across relevant professional platforms, ABA networks, university partnerships, and licensure boards
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening calls to assess candidate qualifications, licensure status, and availability
  • Coordinate and facilitate the interview process in collaboration with the HR Director and clinical leadership
  • Extend offers and manage pre-hire documentation in accordance with LTE Care Plus HR policies
  • Maintain an active and sufficient LBA candidate pipeline to meet organizational service delivery needs without a gap

LBA Accreditation Support (BCBA to LBA Pathway)

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for BCBAs pursuing LBA licensure in New York State
  • Guide BCBA candidates through the LBA application and licensure process, including required documentation, application submission, and timeline expectations
  • Coordinate with the HR Director and clinical leadership to structure the organizational support provides to BCBAs seeking LBA accreditation
  • Track each BCBA's accreditation progress and maintain documentation of all steps completed
  • Ensure LBAs-in-process are not assigned to billable clinical roles until full licensure is confirmed

Medicaid Partnership Facilitation

  • Facilitate the Medicaid provider enrollment process for all incoming LBAs in partnership
  • Collect and submit all required documentation for Medicaid enrollment on behalf of newly hired LBAs
  • Track enrollment application status and follow up with Medicaid authorities or the LBA as needed to resolve delays
  • Maintain a complete record of each LBA's Medicaid enrollment status, effective dates, and provider identification numbers in the HRIS
  • Communicate enrollment timelines clearly to clinical operations to prevent unauthorized service delivery before enrollment confirmation
  • Escalate any enrollment denials, revalidations, or compliance issues to the HR Director immediately

Accreditation & Credential Maintenance

  • Maintain a master tracking system for all active LBA license expiration dates, Medicaid revalidation deadlines, and continuing education requirements
  • Send proactive renewal reminder communications to all LBAs no less than 90 days before any credential expiration
  • Follow up with LBAs who do not respond to renewal reminders and escalate to the HR Director if expiration risk remains unresolved
  • Remove or flag any LBA with a lapsed credential from active clinical assignment status immediately and notify the HR Director and operations team
  • Ensure zero active LBAs hold expired credentials at any point, maintain 100% compliance across the LBA workforce
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready credentialing files for every LBA in the HRIS

HRIS Administration

  • Enter all LBA new hire information into the HRIS on the same business day as hire confirmation
  • Update LBA records at each credentialing milestone, including LBA licensure confirmation, Medicaid enrollment, and credential renewals
  • Ensure all HRIS records are complete, accurate, and reflect the current status of each LBA's employment and credentialing
  • Run HRIS reports on LBA headcount, credential status, and pipeline metrics as requested by the HR Director
  • Identify and correct any data discrepancies in LBA records promptly

Ad Hoc HR Support

  • Complete additional tasks and special projects as assigned by the HR Director
  • Support HR operations during audits, regulatory reviews, or compliance initiatives involving LBA workforce documentation
  • Assist with the development of LBA onboarding materials, credential tracking tools, or process improvement initiatives as directed
  • Participate in HR team meetings and contribute to department-wide workflow improvements

Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in recruiting, credentialing, provider enrollment, or HR operations required
  • Prior experience in a healthcare, behavioral health, or ABA setting strongly preferred
  • Experience with Medicaid provider enrollment processes is highly preferred
  • Familiarity with New York State LBA licensure requirements and the BCBA-to-LBA pathway is a significant advantage
  • Prior HRIS administration experience required; experience with Zoho or similar platforms preferred
  • Skills & Competencies
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple LBA credentialing timelines simultaneously
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills for outreach to clinical professionals
  • High attention to detail and commitment to zero-defect credentialing records
  • Ability to manage sensitive professional and regulatory information with discretion
  • Self-directed with the ability to meet compliance deadlines without prompting
  • Understanding of ABA therapy service delivery and the clinical role of the LBA in a Medicaid funded service model
  • Proficiency with HRIS platforms, spreadsheet tracking tools, and professional communication platforms

Minimum Technical and Work Environment Requirements:

    • Internet Connection:
      • Primary internet connection with a minimum speed of 15 Mbps.
      • Backup internet connection with at least 10 Mbps.
      • Backup connection must be capable of supporting work during a power outage.
    • Primary Device:
      • Desktop or laptop equipped with at least:
        • Intel Core i5 (8th generation or newer), Intel Core i3 (10th generation or newer), AMD Ryzen 5, or an equivalent processor.
        • A minimum of 8 GB RAM.
    • Backup Device:
      • Must meet or exceed the performance of an Intel Core i3 processor.
      • Must be functional during power interruptions.
    • Peripherals and Workspace:
      • A functioning webcam.
      • A noise-canceling USB headset.
      • A quiet, dedicated home office space.
      • A smartphone for communication and verification purposes.

Benefits

  • Join Our Dynamic Team: Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Embrace the Opportunities: Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.
  • Limitless Career Growth: Unlock a world of possibilities and resources to propel your career forward.
  • Fast-Paced Thrills: Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.
  • Flexibility, Your Way: Embrace the freedom to work from home or any location of your choice. Create your ideal work environment.
  • Work-Life Balance at Its Best: Say goodbye to stressful commutes and hello to quality time with loved ones. Achieve a healthy work-life integration to perform at your best.

jobs.description:
Proposal & Bid Manager – Enterprise & Government Contracts

Department: Commercial / Sales Enablement
Employment Type: Full-Time
Level: Manager

Position Overview

Globalli is seeking a Proposal & Bid Manager to lead the end-to-end proposal and bid lifecycle for enterprise, mid-market, government, and public-sector opportunities, as well as strategic client renewals and expansions.

This role will serve as the central owner and project manager for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, procurement questionnaires, government solicitations, and other formal competitive processes. The Proposal & Bid Manager will partner closely with Sales, Solutions Consulting, Legal, Finance, Product, Technology, Information Security, Compliance, Implementation, Operations, and executive leadership to develop accurate, compelling, compliant, commercially competitive submissions.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional proposal management and writing skills with a strong commercial mindset. This person will understand how to translate Globalli's global payroll, workforce technology, compliance, implementation, security, and commercial capabilities into persuasive, customer-specific responses designed to win business.

Key Responsibilities

Proposal & Bid Management

  • Own the end-to-end management of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, procurement questionnaires, and formal proposal processes.

  • Analyze solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria, mandatory qualifications, contractual requirements, risks, deadlines, and submission requirements.

  • Develop bid plans, response matrices, timelines, ownership assignments, review cycles, and submission schedules.

  • Coordinate cross-functional contributors and ensure complete, accurate, consistent, and timely submissions.

  • Manage multiple concurrent bids with competing priorities and immovable deadlines.

Government & Public-Sector Opportunities

  • Manage government and public-sector bids from solicitation through submission, clarification, negotiation, and award.

  • Identify procurement, contractual, compliance, security, insurance, financial, technical, and documentation requirements requiring internal review or escalation.

  • Maintain organized records of solicitations, amendments, clarification questions, submissions, procurement communications, evaluations, and awards.

Sales Enablement & Deal Strategy

  • Partner with Sales leadership and Account Executives on strategic enterprise and government opportunities.

  • Develop customer-specific messaging, executive summaries, value propositions, competitive differentiators, and win themes.

  • Support clarification rounds, bidder conferences, presentations, demonstrations, Best and Final Offers, commercial negotiations, and award processes.

  • Support structured bid/no-bid decisions based on strategic fit, revenue potential, customer requirements, competitive position, probability of award, delivery feasibility, resources, and risk.

Existing Client Expansion & Renewals

  • Manage formal procurement processes associated with renewals, competitive rebids, geographic expansion, and expanded scopes of service.

  • Partner with Account Management and Commercial leadership to support retention and expansion opportunities.

  • Coordinate responses involving Globalli's Global Payroll, Employer of Record, Contractor Management, Entity Management, workforce technology, payments, and related services.

Proposal Content & Knowledge Management

  • Develop persuasive, customer-specific proposal content that clearly differentiates Globalli.

  • Build and maintain a centralized proposal content library covering products, global coverage, implementation, security, privacy, compliance, integrations, service levels, commercial models, references, and standard responses.

  • Establish standardized templates, response frameworks, and quality standards.

  • Continuously improve content based on product changes, regulatory developments, market positioning, customer feedback, and bid outcomes.

Commercial & Contract Coordination

  • Coordinate with Legal and Commercial leadership on customer MSAs, SOWs, procurement terms, data-processing agreements, security requirements, insurance requirements, and related documentation.

  • Identify material contractual, commercial, compliance, or operational issues and ensure appropriate escalation.

  • Maintain strong version control and documentation throughout proposal and contract negotiations.

  • This role does not replace legal counsel but must recognize issues requiring legal or executive review.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain a centralized pipeline of active, upcoming, submitted, awarded, and unsuccessful bids.

  • Track bid volume, value, turnaround time, win rate, contract value awarded, submission timeliness, and reasons for wins and losses.

  • Conduct post-bid reviews and use insights to continuously improve proposal strategy, content, and processes.

  • Provide Commercial leadership with visibility into active opportunities, deadlines, resource requirements, risks, and performance.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in proposal management, bid management, RFP management, enterprise procurement, government contracting, sales enablement, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, or formal procurement processes through submission and award.

  • Experience supporting enterprise and/or mid-market B2B sales opportunities.

  • Demonstrated success contributing to or managing competitive bids and contract awards.

  • Exceptional commercial writing, editing, proofreading, and executive communication skills.

  • Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to interpret complex technical, commercial, contractual, compliance, security, and procurement requirements.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and document-management discipline.

  • Ability to manage multiple high-priority opportunities simultaneously.

  • Confidence working with senior Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, Technology, Security, Compliance, Operations, and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in global payroll, HCM, HR technology, PEO, SaaS, FinTech/payments, workforce management, professional services, or government contracting.

  • Government or public-sector procurement experience.

  • Experience managing multinational or multi-country RFPs.

  • Experience coordinating complex proposals involving technology, implementation, information security, data privacy, compliance, pricing, and contractual requirements.

  • Experience with bid/capture strategy, bid/no-bid processes, win themes, and competitive positioning.

Key Competencies

  • Commercial Mindset: Focuses on winning qualified opportunities, not simply submitting compliant responses.

  • Exceptional Writing: Translates complex information into clear, persuasive customer-facing content.

  • Project Leadership: Creates accountability across multiple teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Strategic Thinking: Understands evaluation criteria and develops responses around factors that influence buying decisions.

  • Attention to Detail: Identifies omissions, inconsistencies, and requirements that could affect an award.

  • Executive Presence: Comfortable working with senior leaders, legal counsel, technical teams, procurement professionals, and customers.

  • Ownership: Owns the bid lifecycle from opportunity intake through submission, award, and post-bid analysis.

Measures of Success

Success will be measured through improved bid quality and effectiveness, including win rate, contract value awarded, on-time submission rates, response turnaround times, internal coordination, proposal quality, and performance across enterprise and government opportunities.

Within the first 6–12 months, this individual will establish a structured RFP process, centralized content library, bid calendar, bid/no-bid framework, standardized templates, performance reporting, and a scalable operating model for Globalli's growing enterprise and government business.

Job Title: Oncology Account Manager

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

Our business purpose:

We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

Who thrives here:

You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make a difference for patients. We work to remove ambiguity from patient care in a space where every decision matters, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.

As an Oncology Account Manager, your primary responsibility will be selling GE HealthCare’s PET Imaging Agent (Cerianna). This is a wing-to-wing, multi-faceted Account Manager role that has multiple call points and strategic priorities. Call points will primarily focus on PET Imaging Centers, PET technologists, Radiology Management, Radiologists, and Supply Chain. In addition, the role will help support driving demand and call on Medical Oncologists and Breast Surgeons to provide information and education on Cerianna, reimbursement resources, etc. to drive demand for the product into Imaging Centers. Third, a critical call point are pharmacy partners who manufacture the product and in-field collaboration to drive new business.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Developing and executing on a multi-faceted territory plan that includes partnering with hospitals / imaging centers to offer imaging services to utilize Cerianna.
  • Position Cerianna as a molecular imaging diagnostic PET agent for recurrent or metastatic ER+ breast cancer and properly position in the breast cancer patient care pathway.
  • Identify the top referring health care providers, foster relationships, and appropriately impact the decision-making criteria to help increase awareness about Cerianna.
  • Be a trusted advisor to imaging centers and referrers to help unlock opportunities to access Cerianna and remove barriers to ordering Cerianna.
  • Collaborate with reimbursement market access support teams to optimize payor contract implementation and satisfaction across imaging centers and hospitals.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy channel partners to meet the customer’s product delivery goals and expectations.
  • Pre-call planning and in-call questioning to understand customer needs, craft solutions and drive utilization.
  • Monitor territory plan performance and results, collaborate on next action steps with cross-functional partners.
  • Virtual selling and cold calling to new and existing targets.
  • Providing pricing strategy, price negotiation and contract management, and ensuring pricing compliance for segment opportunities.
  • Forecasting orders and sales of assigned territory and submit weekly progress reports.
  • Representing the company at healthcare conferences and seminars to promote our products and company.
  • Have a deep understanding of the Imaging Center / Hospital department goals, needs, workflow, financial expectations, etc. around PET imaging.
  • Coordinate with the Strategic Account Managers on broader health care system strategies to drive demand and remove barriers to access Cerianna.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college or valid and current certification through the NMTCB or AART
  • 3+ years sales experience or relevant experience in a medical, healthcare, technical, pharmaceutical or Life Sciences field
  • Experience selling into hospitals, contracting, and supply chain or relevant clinical experience in a healthcare setting
  • Proven track record of sales success, developing, organizing and implementing sales plans, meeting and exceeding sales targets, and penetrating new accounts/markets/competitive through proficiency in prospecting, lead qualification, sales and negotiations or relevant experience in a healthcare organization leading successful adoption of new ideas, programs, or initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve objectives while operating in compliance with regulatory guidelines
  • Demonstrated communication skills, analytical skills and Nuclear Medicine/PET/pharmaceutical industry acumen
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities through effective organizational, people, and time management skills
  • Must be willing to reside in the territory
  • Must be willing and able to do 50% overnight travel.

Desired Characteristics

  • Desire to work in start-up styled business where the drive to establish and grow markets
  • 3+ years of Oncology and/or nuclear medicine industry experience
  • Awareness of clinical tools and drive adoption is key to success
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team setting towards meeting established objectives
  • Ability to apply a range of traditional and nontraditional problem-solving techniques to think through and solve complex issues creatively to improve performance and company effectiveness.
  • Ability to build rapport and relationships by interacting effectively with employees and external contacts (i.e. MD and office staff) at all levels, demonstrating the awareness of their needs and responding with the appropriate action
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Strong presentation skills
