Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

jobs.title: Director, Product Strategy & Operations (Product Adoption)
jobs.excerpt: About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale.
jobs.description:
About HighLevel:HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People:
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact:
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Responsibilities:

    Why this role exists :

    We are looking for a Director, Product Strategy & Operations – Product Adoption to drive how customers discover, adopt, engage with, and derive value from HighLevel’s products and capabilities.

    This role will sit at the intersection of Product Strategy, Product Management, Growth, Customer Success, Data, and Operations. The primary mandate is to identify adoption gaps across the customer journey, translate data and customer insights into clear strategic priorities, and partner with product teams to improve activation, feature adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.

    This is not a traditional program management or product operations role. We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, strong analytical depth, customer understanding, and execution to influence product roadmaps and materially improve adoption across the platform

What You'll Do

    Product Adoption Strategy

    • Define and drive HighLevel’s product adoption strategy across key products, features, and customer segments.
    • Identify the biggest barriers preventing customers from discovering, activating, and repeatedly using high-value capabilities.
    • Develop frameworks to measure adoption across the customer lifecycle—from onboarding and activation through sustained engagement and expansion.
    • Prioritize adoption opportunities based on customer impact, business value, and strategic importance.

      • Adoption & Growth Analytics

      • Establish clear adoption metrics and success criteria for strategic product initiatives.
      • Analyze customer journeys, funnels, cohorts, feature usage, and behavioral patterns to identify opportunities and friction points.
      • Partner with Data and Product teams to understand time-to-value, activation, feature penetration, engagement, retention, and churn.
      • Segment adoption by customer type, cohort, geography, product, and use case to uncover actionable insights.
      • Build executive-level visibility into product adoption performance and emerging risks.

        • Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence

        • Translate adoption insights into actionable product recommendations.
        • Partner with Product leaders to influence roadmaps based on customer behavior, adoption gaps, and business priorities.
        • Identify opportunities where onboarding, UX, education, packaging, cross-product journeys, or product capabilities need to change to improve adoption.
        • Develop business cases for high-impact adoption initiatives and help teams prioritize investments.

          • Cross-Functional Execution

          • Partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Revenue teams.
          • Drive cross-functional initiatives aimed at increasing adoption of strategic product capabilities.
          • Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, metrics, and accountability for adoption initiatives.
          • Ensure product launches go beyond shipping by defining how new capabilities will achieve meaningful customer adoption.

            • Customer & Market Insights

            • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs, workflows, pain points, and reasons for non-adoption.
            • Combine quantitative product data with qualitative customer insights to identify root causes.
            • Partner with customer-facing teams to establish systematic feedback loops into Product.
            • Benchmark adoption and customer experience against relevant SaaS and technology platforms.

What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

    • Increase activation and adoption of strategic product capabilities.
    • Improve time-to-value for new and existing customers.
    • Increase feature penetration and depth of product usage.
    • Improve engagement and repeat usage of high-value workflows.
    • Reduce adoption-related friction and early customer drop-off.
    • Establish measurable relationships between product adoption and retention, expansion, and customer value.
    • Build a scalable operating model for measuring and improving adoption across HighLevel.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 12+ years of experience across Product Strategy, Growth, Product Management, Product Operations, Strategy & Operations, or related functions, with meaningful leadership experience.
  • Strong experience driving product adoption, activation, engagement, retention, or product-led growth within a technology/SaaS business.
  • Demonstrated ability to use product and customer data to identify problems and drive strategic decisions.
  • Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, segmentation, experimentation, retention, and customer lifecycle metrics.
  • Track record of influencing Product roadmaps and senior stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Ability to move comfortably between executive-level strategy and hands-on problem solving.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, particularly when translating complex data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB products, platform businesses, or multi-product ecosystems is highly preferred.

EEO Statement:

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

jobs.description:
VP, People

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Reports to the CHRO | Remote, US-based

Salary range: $210,000 - $230,000, plus 30% target annual bonus and RSUs

How We Got Here

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

We need a builder to run People at a public, remote-first company scaling through roughly the 500-1000 range while expanding internationally. You'll design the systems that make Backblaze a great place to work when there's no office doing that job for us - engagement, culture, communications, retention, succession, and manager development - and you'll run a small HR Operations and strategic HRBP team to do it.

This isn't a maintenance role. The operational foundation is already in place; you'll build the next layer on top of it, with your team, using AI agents as part of how the work gets done. If your instinct is to scope a vendor and a project plan, or disappear for six weeks and come back with a deck, this isn't the right fit. If your instinct is to open a doc, pull your team in, and start building the first version together, keep reading.

What You Will Own

Build

  • Making Backblaze an even better place to work when there is no office carrying it for us. That means designing connection, belonging, and teamwork into how the company operates rather than hoping they happen on their own.
  • Engagement as a leader-owned discipline with outcomes, not a survey followed by silence. People want to connect their work to where the company is going. You build the system that makes that real.
  • Strategic employee and leader communications: a standing rhythm that gives people line of sight to the strategy, tells the same story every quarter, and makes sure information reaches every geography and every time zone.
  • Culture as a design output. We are remote-first, expanding internationally, and growing fast. Connection, recognition, and belonging stop happening by accident at this stage. If we do not design them, distance designs them for us. Onboarding, team rituals, and the few in-person moments a year get designed and budgeted like anything else that matters.
  • Remote working excellence: one company, many geographies. Same expectations, same development, same voice in the room, wherever someone sits. Offshore is where we hire, not a tier of employees.
  • Retention and succession: knowing who is at risk before they resign, building the bench underneath key roles, and making sure we are not one resignation away from a gap we cannot fill.
  • A learning organization: manager capability rebuilt for distributed teams, internal mobility, cross-functional movement, and development that survives contact with a busy quarter. What it means to be a manager at Backblaze is changing as spans widen, AI reshapes teams, and most managers rarely see their people. You rewrite those expectations.
  • Partnering with our AI Transformation Leader on how AI changes work design, job architecture, and team structure across the company.

Own

You will run a small, high-impact HR Operations and strategic HRBP team. The operational foundation is already in place. You inherit it, make sure it stays clean, and evolve it as we scale internationally.

What You Will Personally Build in Year One

Build - but build with the team, not over them. The point is not to arrive with finished answers. It is to bring people into the work, raise their skills along the way, and communicate constantly so the whole team understands what is being built and why.

  • The engagement program and the operating rhythm behind it, designed so leaders own the outcomes, not HR
  • How remote teams work here, written down and adopted, not aspirational. Recognition that reaches people in every geography and every time zone.
  • The employee and leader communications cadence that gives people a clear line of sight to the strategy
  • The retention model and the succession plan, including what we do with what they tell us
  • The manager development approach for a company where managers rarely see their people and where what it means to manage is being rewritten
  • The design of our in-person moments: offsites, team gatherings, and the few times a year people are in a room together

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • You have operated teams outside the United States. EOR or owned entities both count. What matters is that you have managed the reality of employing people in other countries, not that you have read about it. We are expanding internationally and the pace is accelerating.
  • You have scaled a company through roughly this stage - somewhere in the 500-1000 range, with international arriving partway through. You have seen what breaks. We are building critical AI infrastructure, expanding globally, and the thesis is more output per person from a more distributed, more AI-enabled workforce.
  • You are a builder who builds with people, not around them. You have written the framework, run the session, built the thing - recently, with your own hands - and you brought your team along while doing it. You develop people through work, not separate from it.
  • You use AI agents in your daily work. This is a filter, not a preference. We are 250+ people on Claude Enterprise, our managers will be running blended human and agent teams in 2027.
  • You lead a team and are still close enough to the work to know when it is good.
  • You care about making a company a great place to work and you know how to do it when people are distributed across geographies, time zones, and cultures.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Comfortable that this is a public company, without needing to have run a proxy. You will not be surprised by comp committee timing, disclosure windows, or audit season, but the CHRO owns that work.
  • Coming from a strong mid-sized technology company rather than a large enterprise. Not a rule, but the pattern matters: we need someone who has built in conditions of scarcity, not someone who has run a function with a large team and a large budget already in place.
  • Either a first-time VP ready to step up or a second-time VP who wants to build rather than administer. We care about the person, not the number of times they have held the title.
  • A strong communicator who over-communicates by instinct. In a remote company, silence is the default and it is corrosive.

This Is Not the Role for You If

  • Your strength is running an established function well and you want a bigger version of that
  • You need a large team to be effective
  • You do not default to building and running POCs
  • You want to spend most of your time on executive comp and board work
  • You think culture is a benefits problem or an office problem rather than a design problem

How We Will Interview

We will ask you to bring something you built, walk us through the version that did not work, and tell us what you would do differently. We will ask how you use AI in your own work, specifically. And you will spend real time with the HRBPs and HR Ops team, because they will work with you every day and their read matters.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity package
  • Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with matching
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • A collaborative and transparent culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

The expected salary range for this role is $210,000 - $230,000 plus 30% target annual bonus and RSUs.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Vice President of Sales - EMEA
jobs.excerpt: Who are Evotix? We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently.
jobs.description:
Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

The Vice President of Sales - EMEA is accountable for the region's new business strategy and performance. This role translates Evotix's growth priorities into a focused go-to-market plan, clear operating rhythms and consistent execution across EMEA.

You will lead and develop the EMEA sales organisation, partnering closely with Business Development and Marketing to build pipeline, improve conversion and win the right customers.

Success will be measured through sustainable revenue growth, forecast accuracy, sales productivity and the strength of the regional team.

What You'll Do

Set EMEA Sales Strategy

  • Own and execute the EMEA sales strategy in line with company goals, target markets and customer needs.
  • Turn regional priorities into clear coverage, capacity, territory and account plans.
  • Use market, customer and performance insight to focus investment and adapt the regional approach.
  • Provide the CEO and leadership team with clear recommendations on growth opportunities, risks and trade-offs.

Deliver Predictable Revenue Growth

  • Take accountability for EMEA new business performance and agreed revenue outcomes.
  • Set clear targets and leading indicators, reviewing progress regularly and acting early where performance is off track.

jobs.description:
About Product

VyOS is an open-source network operating system that provides an all-in-one platform for network management. Built on Linux, VyOS integrates powerful routing, firewall, VPN, and network services into a unified system. Unlike traditional networking hardware, VyOS can be deployed on a wide range of platforms, from physical routers and cloud environments to virtual machines, giving users flexibility and control over their network infrastructure.

The key strength of VyOS lies in its comprehensive feature set. It supports dynamic routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP), multiple VPN types (IPsec, OpenVPN, WireGuard), firewall rules, traffic shaping, and more - all configured through a unified command-line interface (CLI) familiar to network engineers. Its ability to scale across various environments makes it popular with organizations seeking open-source networking solutions.

Job description

The Content Marketing Manager owns the content lifecycle end-to-end: planning, writing, editing, publishing, and measuring. Today, content publication at VyOS requires a web developer; this role closes that gap. The Content Marketing Manager works directly in the headless CMS (DatoCMS) and blog platform (HubSpot), turning drafts, customer interviews, and product updates into published pages without engineering involvement, executing the content strategy, messaging, and campaign priorities set by the Head of Marketing.

Reports to: Head of Marketing.

Responsibilities

Content production and publishing

  • Run the content production and publication calendar across all web properties: main website (DatoCMS), blog (HubSpot), and social channels, executing against priorities set with the Head of Marketing.
  • Write and edit blog posts, product/solution pages, landing pages, and email content. Draft press releases to the Head of Marketing's messaging; final messaging and release approval stay with the Head of Marketing.
  • Publish and maintain content directly in DatoCMS using the Marketing Editor role: create records, manage assets, use draft/preview workflow, publish. No coding required; schema changes remain with the web development team.
  • Own the customer Success Story pipeline: interview coordination, drafting, customer approval loop, publication (landing page + PDF + social announcement).

Content operations

  • Act as the marketing-side owner of CMS content quality: image sizing and alt text, metadata, slugs, structured fields, internal linking.
  • Coordinate with the web development team when content requires new page templates, blocks, or schema changes — write the requirement, not the code.
  • Maintain content governance: what lives where (website vs. blog vs. docs vs. knowledge base), avoiding duplication across properties.

SEO / discoverability

  • Own on-page SEO for marketing content: titles, meta descriptions, headings, structured data fields exposed in the CMS.
  • Contribute to answer-engine optimization (AEO) efforts: content structured for LLM/AI-assistant consumption.
  • Monitor content performance (GA4, Search Console, HubSpot analytics) and produce a monthly content report with actions.

Distribution

  • Repurpose long-form content into social posts, newsletter items, and community forum announcements.
  • Coordinate publication timing with product releases, events, and campaigns.

Cross-functional

  • Translate engineering and product material into accurate, readable marketing content; verify technical claims with engineers before publishing.
  • Support sales with content assets: one-pagers, comparison pages, battlecards.

Requirements

Skills

  • Hands-on experience with a headless CMS (DatoCMS, Contentful, Sanity, Storyblok, or similar) — comfortable working in structured content models, not just WYSIWYG editors.
  • Native-level written English; ability to edit technical drafts from non-native speakers into clean prose.
  • Working knowledge of on-page SEO and web analytics (GA4, Search Console).
  • Ability to read technical documentation and hold a credible conversation with network engineers about what a feature does — you do not need to configure BGP, but you must not misdescribe it.
  • Self-directed; comfortable in a distributed team using Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

Experience

  • 3+ years in content marketing or content management for a technical/B2B product (networking, infrastructure, developer tools, open source strongly preferred).

Nice to have

  • Networking/IT industry background or certifications (e.g., CCNA-level familiarity).
  • Experience with HubSpot (blog + email + CRM).
  • Experience in open-source communities (forums, GitHub-adjacent content, community announcements).
  • Basic Markdown/HTML literacy; familiarity with Git-based workflows.
  • Experience producing customer case studies including interview and approval management.

Work Conditions and Compensation

Fully Remote Work: This 100% remote position allows you to work anywhere.

Flexible Work Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule that allows you to manage your time while ensuring effective collaboration across our globally distributed teams. The official workday starts between 8 AM and 11 AM (employee local time) and ends between 5 PM and 8 PM (employee local time). While flexibility is encouraged, occasional work outside typical hours may be required to align with colleagues in different time zones. Open communication and availability for cross-time-zone meetings are essential for seamless teamwork.

Time Tracking: Employees are required to use time tracker software to monitor working hours and productivity.

Vacation: Enjoy 20 days of annual paid vacation

National Holidays: You are entitled to up to 10 days of paid leave for recognized national holidays.

Sick Leave: is provided in accordance with company policy

About VyOS Networks

VyOS Networks is a company dedicated to creating cutting-edge, open-source network solutions that empower organizations to manage their networks with flexibility and control. As the company behind the VyOS network operating system, we are committed to delivering a robust, scalable, and secure platform that meets the diverse needs of businesses, service providers, and network professionals worldwide.

At VyOS Networks, our work goes beyond just providing technology - we’re shaping the future of networking with a global, community-driven project. We foster an environment where talented individuals come together to solve complex networking challenges, while continuously improving both our products and ourselves.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

Our Core Values

Our values define who we are as a team and how we approach our work every day:

  • Respect: We believe in fostering a respectful environment where we value each other's perspectives and contributions. We maintain a deep respect for our colleagues, our open-source community, and our clients, ensuring that all interactions are guided by understanding, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Responsibility: Trust is the foundation of our success. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of honesty, dependability, and accountability. Whether delivering on a commitment to a client or collaborating with a team member, we take responsibility for our actions and their impact.
  • Improvement: We are driven by a relentless desire to improve - ourselves, our products, and the world of networking. Continuous learning, innovation, and refining our processes are key to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

  • Liderazgo de Liquidez y Cash Management: Supervisar y gestionar los flujos de caja a nivel global, asegurando disponibilidad de fondos para las necesidades operativas y de inversión de todas las entidades del grupo.

The Company

Marigold is a fast-growing marketing technology company helping growing businesses build stronger customer relationships through its three core platforms: Emma, Campaign Monitor, and Vuture. We deliver powerful tools for email, SMS, and marketing automation that elevate engagement and drive real results. Marigold is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee with offices in Sydney and London.

The Role

The Sales Development Associate is Marigold's entry point into a sales career - and it's designed for someone taking their first job out of college. No prior sales experience is required. In fact, we're specifically looking for recent graduates who want to learn the fundamentals of the profession in an environment built to teach them. Your focus is twofold. First, you'll help prospects get up and running on Campaign Monitor's self-serve platform, guiding new users from sign-up to first successful campaign. Second, you'll reach out to marketing agencies to introduce Campaign Monitor as a solution for both their own marketing and their clients' - building the habit of proactive outreach that defines a strong sales career. This is a remote, US-based role with structured onboarding, daily coaching, and a defined path into our Sales Development Representative I position.

What You'll Do

  • Support prospects and new users through Campaign Monitor self-serve onboarding, helping them activate their account, launch a first campaign, and find early value in the platform.

  • Conduct outbound outreach - calls, emails, and social - to marketing agencies to introduce Campaign Monitor as a solution for their business and their clients.

  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand what a prospect is trying to accomplish, and share what you learn with the broader sales team.

  • Identify self-serve users and agency contacts whose needs point toward a larger opportunity, and route them to the appropriate Sales Development Representative or Account Executive.

  • Follow up on inbound sign-ups, trials, and marketing-generated leads with speed and consistency.

  • Maintain accurate CRM activity and contact records so the team has a clear picture of every conversation.

  • Participate actively in training, call reviews, role plays, and coaching sessions designed to build your prospecting and discovery skills.

  • Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales teammates to improve the self-serve and agency experience, sharing what you hear directly from users.

About You

You're a recent graduate who is curious about people and energized by conversation. You aren't intimidated by picking up the phone, and you'd rather learn by doing than wait until you feel fully ready. When something doesn't go well, you want to know why - and you're eager for the feedback that helps you get better.

You're organized enough to manage a full day of outreach and follow-up, resilient enough to keep momentum after a string of no's, and motivated by clear goals. You want a first job that teaches you a real, durable skill set, and you're looking for a team that will invest in that.

Ideal Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, completed within the past year. This role is intentionally designed as a first job out of school.

  • No professional sales experience required - we'll teach you the craft.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and genuine comfort talking with people you haven't met.

  • Curiosity, a willingness to ask questions, and an interest in how businesses market themselves.

  • Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of daily activity.

  • Coachability and a track record of putting feedback into practice - in academics, athletics, work, or activities.

  • Comfort learning new software tools quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or student work in university admissions or advancement, particularly calling prospective students, alumni, or donors.

  • Any experience in a role requiring outbound calling, fundraising, canvassing, or customer-facing conversations.

  • Campus leadership, athletics, or organizational roles that required persistence and self-direction.

  • Coursework, internships, or personal projects involving marketing, communications, or business.

  • Exposure to email marketing, social media marketing, or marketing agency work.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce.

Location Eligibility

This position is eligible for hire in the following US states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $40,000 annually. This role is also eligible for $10,000 in target annual variable compensation based on individual performance and sales targets, for total target compensation of $50,000 annually.

The compensation range represents the pay the Company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and applicable law.

Benefits

  • Competitive benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life, accident, and disability insurance; supplemental health benefits; FSA; EAP; and pet insurance.

  • Generous time off (we call it Open Time Away), paid holidays, and a birthday benefit day off.

  • Paid Volunteer Time.

  • 401(k) plan with a company match on your contributions.

  • Employee-centric and supportive remote work environment with flexibility.

  • Support for life events, including paid parental leave.

jobs.title: OSINT Analyst - Vessel Identification
jobs.excerpt: Automated detection can find vessels, but cannot always tell you which vessel it is.
jobs.description:
Automated detection can find vessels, but cannot always tell you which vessel it is. When a contact appears in a satellite image with no matching AIS, when an identity has been spoofed or duplicated, when a name and IMO do not agree, or when the models simply return low confidence, a human analyst has to resolve it.

As an OSINT Analyst on Kpler's Maritime Domain Awareness team, you are the adjudication layer behind the machine. You take the detections that automated identification cannot confidently resolve and attach an identity to them: name, IMO, owner, operator, and flag, with the evidence and the confidence to stand behind it. You investigate dark vessels, AIS gaps, GNSS spoofing, and identity manipulation, and you reconstruct the ownership and behaviour that explains what a vessel is really doing.

Your work does two things at once. It makes Kpler's unified vessel record more complete and more trusted for the analysts, compliance desks, and government users who depend on it. And it creates the labelled ground truth that makes the detection models better, so the routine cases keep shrinking and human attention stays on the genuinely hard ones.

Mission

  • Adjudicate the identifications that automated detection cannot resolve: attach a verified identity to dark, spoofed, or low-confidence contacts, with sourced evidence and an explicit confidence level.
  • Investigate identity manipulation and evasion: AIS gaps and dark periods, GNSS and position spoofing, duplicated or borrowed MMSI, name and flag changes, and vessel substitution.
  • Apply open-source intelligence tradecraft: interpret satellite and optical imagery, work ship-photo databases and vessel registries, corporate and beneficial-ownership records, port-state and terminal records, classification and insurance sources, and open reporting.
  • Reconstruct pattern-of-life and ownership-over-time, building the history that turns a single detection into an explained vessel.
  • Produce structured identification records with clear provenance: every conclusion traceable to its sources, confidence stated plainly, and reporting language disciplined and defensible.
  • Feed the model-improvement loop: return ground truth and edge cases to the data science team, and help define where automation should focus next.
  • Uphold sourcing and data-integrity standards across the team, keeping the record accurate, current, and trusted.

Experience & Background

    Essential:

  • 3+ years in intelligence, investigations, maritime analysis, or a related open-source (OSINT) research discipline, with a track record of turning fragmentary evidence into defensible conclusions.
  • Working knowledge of the maritime domain: vessel types and particulars, AIS, registries, flag and ownership structures, and shipping operations.
  • Genuine OSINT tradecraft: source discovery and evaluation, cross-referencing across independent sources, and disciplined handling of uncertainty and provenance.
  • Confidence interpreting imagery (satellite, optical, and ideally SAR) well enough to reason about what a detection is showing.
  • Meticulous, evidence-led documentation and clear written assessments, with careful use of confidence and caveat language.

    • Desirable:

  • Familiarity with sanctions, trade compliance, and evasion typologies (shadow-fleet behaviour, ship-to-ship transfers, chokepoint activity).
  • Experience contributing labelled data or ground truth to machine-learning workflows, or working alongside a data science team.
  • GIS and geospatial tooling, and comfort with large datasets.
  • Additional languages relevant to major shipping and registry jurisdictions.

    • Behavioural Competencies

  • Rigorous and evidence-led, with an instinct for corroboration and a low tolerance for unsupported claims.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, and able to reach and defend a judgement when the picture is incomplete.
  • Structured, methodical, and able to prioritise a queue of investigations under time pressure.
  • Strong communicator, able to write for analysts, compliance teams, and senior stakeholders alike.
  • Curious and collaborative, with a continuous-improvement mindset and a willingness to strengthen the tools around you.

    • Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in international relations, security or intelligence studies, maritime studies, geography, data or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Patient Champion: Remote Pharmacy Student Position

Grapefruit Health · Remote, U.S. · Part-time, Flexible · Pharmacy Students Only

ABOUT GRAPEFRUIT HEALTH

Grapefruit Health is a healthcare services company on a mission to solve the growing staffing shortage in healthcare by putting tomorrow's clinicians to work today.

We train and manage clinical students to conduct remote, telephonic patient interactions using our purpose-built software. The result? Patients receive timely support, healthcare organizations extend their capacity, and you gain meaningful patient communication experience before you graduate.

As a PharmD student, you'll have the opportunity to apply the communication, patient-centered care, and medication knowledge you're developing in the classroom while gaining real-world experience connecting with patients.

THE ROLE

As a GFH Patient Champion, you'll conduct structured, phone-based interactions with patients on behalf of our partner healthcare organizations.

Using our platform and established protocols, you'll check in with patients, complete assessments, support care-gap closure, and escalate concerns to licensed clinical supervisors when appropriate. Depending on the program, conversations may involve medication use and adherence, preventive care, chronic conditions, post-discharge follow-up, and other patient health needs.

All interactions are conducted by phone, no video or in-person contact is required. You can work remotely from a quiet, private location in the U.S.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Complete a minimum of 6 hours of patient outreach per week on a schedule you build around your PharmD coursework

  • Conduct structured patient outreach, assessments, and wellness check-ins using The Grove, Grapefruit Health's platform

  • Engage patients in conversations related to their healthcare needs, which may include medication adherence, preventive care, chronic disease management, and follow-up care

  • Practice clear, patient-centered communication while helping patients better navigate their healthcare needs

  • Document interaction outcomes accurately within the platform

  • Escalate patient safety concerns and clinical questions to a licensed clinical supervisor in real time

  • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times

  • Participate in onboarding training and ongoing team check-ins

TRAINING & SUPERVISION

All new student hires complete an onboarding program lasting 14 days or less, covering our platform, patient communication frameworks, HIPAA requirements, and the protocols used during patient outreach.

Once active, you'll be supported by our Clinical Leadership Team, who are available during your shifts to provide guidance and manage patient escalations.

This role is designed to complement, not replace, the education and experiential training you receive as a PharmD student.

WHAT YOU'LL GAIN

  • Meaningful patient experience before graduation

  • More confidence communicating with real patients

  • Experience discussing healthcare and navigating patient needs in a structured setting

  • A deeper understanding of the barriers that can affect medication adherence and patient outcomes

  • Exposure to healthcare technology and remote patient engagement

  • Professional experience you can add to your resume and discuss in future interviews

  • Flexible, paid work that fits around your PharmD program

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Must be based in the U.S. and a U.S. citizen

  • Must be actively enrolled in an accredited PharmD program at a university in the U.S.

  • Strong interest in patient care and improving the patient experience

  • Strong verbal communication skills or a genuine desire to develop them

  • An interest in applying your pharmacy education beyond the classroom

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

  • Able to commit to a minimum of 6 hours per week

  • Access to a compatible computer and cell phone with SMS capabilities

  • A quiet, private workspace free of background noise and distractions

WHY PHARMACY STUDENTS?

Pharmacists are among the most accessible healthcare professionals, and strong patient communication is at the heart of the profession.

As a Patient Champion, you'll have the opportunity to strengthen the skills that matter throughout your pharmacy career: listening to patients, communicating clearly, understanding barriers to care, and recognizing when additional clinical support is needed.

You'll gain experience working with real patients while developing the confidence to bring your clinical knowledge into patient-centered conversations.

Required with Submission

  • Two-minute or less video explaining why you would be a good fit for Grapefruit Health and why you think learning how to perform care telephonically is important to prepare you to become a clinician. These do not need to be very formal and are mostly for us to evaluate your communication style. Be yourself and have fun with it!

HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

“I’ve had an amazing experience so far with Grapefruit. I am very thankful for this opportunity, and it has boosted my confidence as a future health care professional and with patient interactions.” -Madison, Pharmacy Student

This position works with the VM-ASE Technical Lead, customer process owners, Cloud/DevOps specialists, and AI-assisted analysis staff to deliver a repeatable, high-confidence assessment service.

This position will provide continuous technical assessment support for full‑time, proactive testing of externally and internally visible federal cyber assets. This expands federal visibility by conducting continual assessments of .gov domains, subdomains, and internet‑facing assets to uncover unknown exposures, validate vulnerabilities, and provide agencies with actionable remediation guidance. This role supports the Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Program’s mission to safeguard and secure cyberspace in an environment where the threat of cyber-attack is continuously growing and evolving and is responsible for enhancing the security, resilience, and reliability of the Nation’s cyber and communications infrastructure. The CDM Program defends the United States (U.S.) Federal Information Technology (IT) networks from cybersecurity threats by providing continuous monitoring sensors (tools), diagnosis, mitigation tools, and associated services to strengthen the security posture of Government networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead continuous attack-surface enumeration, vulnerability discovery, controlled validation, change monitoring, triage, reporting, and remediation-support activities.
  • Design scan architecture, asset-attribution logic, rate limits, credential and API handling, validation procedures, and deconfliction safeguards for large-scale production assessment.
  • Direct and mentor junior engineers; review findings, evidence, false-positive determinations, attack paths, severity, and remediation recommendations.
  • Prioritize risk using exposure, exploitability, CISA KEV, EPSS, asset criticality, compensating controls, and mission impact rather than scanner severity alone.
  • Lead rapid analysis of newly exposed or high-risk assets and coordinate urgent notifications, customer clarification, and closure validation.
  • Define requirements for automation, data normalization, dashboards, AI-assisted triage, and integrations with customer tools and authoritative repositories.
  • Produce and technically approve recurring reports, trend analyses, high-risk findings, playbooks, standard operating procedures, and customer briefings.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • The selected candidate must meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information and be able to obtain a Public Trust fitness determination (High Risk).
  • Ability to work in customer-provided remote environments, use customer-approved tools, and comply with rules of engagement, data-handling requirements, evidence controls, deconfliction procedures, and stop-work criteria.
  • Five or more years of attack-surface management, vulnerability assessment, external reconnaissance, penetration testing, or exposure-management experience, including leadership of continuous or large-scale assessment work.
  • Deep knowledge of DNS, TLS/PKI, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, routing, service fingerprinting, cloud-hosting patterns, asset attribution, scanner behavior, and manual vulnerability validation.
  • Experience designing safe high-volume scanning and enumeration workflows with rate control, scope enforcement, evidence capture, false-positive adjudication, and operational deconfliction.
  • Strong automation and integration skills using Python, Go, Bash, APIs, structured data, source control, and repeatable pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical staff, make defensible risk decisions, write high-quality reports, and brief technical and senior stakeholders.
  • One or more relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP/OSCE, GPEN, GXPN, CISSP, GCIH, cloud-security certifications, or equivalent.

Desired:

  • Eight or more years in attack-surface, offensive-security, vulnerability-management, or internet-measurement roles.
  • Experience with federal .gov attack-surface monitoring, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, critical infrastructure, or high-value assets.
  • Advanced use of certificate-transparency, passive DNS, BGP/ASN, internet telemetry, cloud inventories, and exposure-management data sources.
  • Experience integrating findings with SIEM/data-lake, ticketing, visualization, or threat-intelligence platforms.
  • AWS, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, container, or IaC-security experience sufficient to coordinate closely with platform specialists.

Title: Senior Manager, Customer Success Technical Delivery Lead

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Issue Resolution: Debug custom and base code to provide workarounds or solutions to third party implementation teams or customers. This requires a deep understanding of the application and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Continuously analyze deployment outcomes, identify opportunities for enhanced efficiency and reliability, and implement best practices to improve future upgrade processes

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote position

About your new role:

CommandLink is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own large systems inside the platform that Fortune 1000 companies rely on to run their networks. You will work primarily in Go and Python across the services, APIs, and data pipelines that ingest and act on telemetry from ISP circuits, SD-WAN, SASE, and security infrastructure.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own the design and long-term health of significant parts of the platform, coordinate with engineers on other teams when your work crosses their boundaries, and be one of the people the org depends on when something in production is not behaving. Mentorship and design leadership are part of the job, not a side project.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own large components, services, or projects end to end, from design through operation, and coordinate across teams when the work extends beyond your own.
  • Design solutions to high complexity problems with availability, reliability, and long-term maintainability as first-class constraints, not afterthoughts.
  • Build and evolve backend services in Go and data and automation tooling in Python, including the APIs and event pipelines that connect them.
  • Act as a primary driver when production issues surface: lead the response, run the post-mortem, and own the long-term fix rather than the quick patch.
  • Take on independent greenfield work where a new service or capability is the right answer, and help the team decide when to spike, when to ship an MVP, and when to invest in foundations.
  • Instigate design discussions and give clear technical direction, pushing back on over-engineering while advocating for fixing what is under-built.
  • Teach and mentor actively, review code with an eye toward growing the person as well as improving the change, and share context that makes the whole team faster.
  • Improve engineering productivity through better tooling, testing, and deployment practices, and measure whether those changes actually helped.
  • Contribute to team goals and delivery plans, and play a real part in hiring and interviewing as the team grows.
  • Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

What you'll need for success:

Required

  • Significant professional experience building and operating production backend systems, with deep working knowledge of Go and Python.
  • Mastery of your primary languages and frameworks, and a strong grasp of how a large codebase and its services fit together rather than just the piece in front of you.
  • A track record of owning systems at scale, including the operational side: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and post-mortems.
  • Experience designing distributed systems and APIs, with sound judgment about data modeling, failure modes, and performance tradeoffs.
  • Comfort working across a variety of development approaches and patterns, and the judgment to pick the one that fits the problem.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring other engineers and leading technical design discussions.
  • Strong collaboration instincts: you assume positive intent, offer opposing views without defensiveness, and change your mind when the context warrants it.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecom, networking, or connectivity, including familiarity with concepts like SD-WAN, SASE, BGP, or circuit provisioning. This is a plus, not a prerequisite. We expect to teach the domain to a strong engineer.
  • Experience with event streaming and high volume telemetry ingestion.
  • Cloud infrastructure and container orchestration experience, including infrastructure as code.
  • Experience applying AI and machine learning to operational data such as anomaly detection, classification, or automated remediation.

Why you'll love life at Command|Link

Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

  • Room to grow at a high-growth company
  • An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
  • Your work will have a tangible impact
  • Flexible time off
  • Fun events at cool locations
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

    • Saturdays and Sundays: 9:30 am CST to 5:30 pm CST

  • Desire to help students recognize, reach for, and realize their fullest potential

Two things set Vanguard apart from other after school companies: our elite team and our personalized, organic curriculum. Our experienced instructors and counselors strive to shatter this assembly line model by focusing on core learning rather than short-term strategies and tips, tailoring instruction to fit each student’s individual needs. jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenAls Cybersecurity Analist Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management draag je bij aan de verdere uitbouw, uitvoering en optimalisatie van de dienstverlening rond vulnerability management, attack surface management en cyber awareness binnen de Vlaamse overheid.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Cybersecurity Analist Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management draag je bij aan de verdere uitbouw, uitvoering en optimalisatie van de dienstverlening rond vulnerability management, attack surface management en cyber awareness binnen de Vlaamse overheid.

Je analyseert en beoordeelt informatie over kwetsbaarheden, blootgestelde systemen en beveiligingsrisico's. Je valideert bevindingen, plaatst ze in de juiste risicocontext en vertaalt ze naar concrete aanbevelingen. Daarbij ondersteun je Vlaamse entiteiten en lokale besturen bij het prioriteren, opvolgen en remediëren van vastgestelde risico's.

Automatisering is een essentieel onderdeel van deze functie. Door het grote aantal bronnen, datastromen en doelgroepen ontwikkel en onderhoud je scripts en API-integraties, hoofdzakelijk in Python, voor de verzameling, verrijking, correlatie, opvolging en rapportering van kwetsbaarheidsinformatie.

Je werkt nauw samen met interne collega's, externe partners en vertegenwoordigers van Vlaamse entiteiten en lokale besturen. Zo maak je kwetsbaarheden en blootgestelde systemen tijdig inzichtelijk en ondersteun je organisaties met heldere en bruikbare aanbevelingen.

Daarnaast lever je ook een bijdrage aan initiatieven rond cyber awareness en phishingsimulaties. De functie is sterk uitvoerend en operationeel, en combineert inhoudelijke security-expertise met actieve betrokkenheid bij de dagelijkse werking van de dienstverlening.

Kerntaken

  • Analyseren van kwetsbaarheden en blootstellingen op basis van diverse bronnen.
  • Valideren van bevindingen, filteren van ruis en false positives, en inschatten van de reële impact voor betrokken organisaties.
  • Risicogebaseerd prioriteren van bevindingen op basis van onder meer CVSS, EPSS, exploitatiestatus en organisatiecontext.
  • Formuleren van overkoepelende inzichten, trends en organisatiespecifieke aanbevelingen op basis van geanalyseerde informatie.
  • Ontsluiten van bevindingen via passende rapporterings- en communicatiekanalen, afgestemd op technische en niet-technische doelgroepen.
  • Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van scripts en API-integraties in Python voor dataverzameling, verrijking, correlatie en rapportering.
  • Ondersteunen bij de opvolging van remediatieacties via ticketing- en workflowsystemen.
  • Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en evalueren van cyber awareness-initiatieven en phishingsimulaties.
  • Bijdragen aan documentatie, standaardisatie en de continue verbetering van processen, werkwijzen en ondersteunende oplossingen.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als cybersecurity analist binnen vulnerability management, met focus op de identificatie en opvolging van kwetsbaarheden.
  • Je hebt ervaring als Security Consultant in minstens één van de volgende domeinen: data, infrastructuur of applicaties.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare expertise binnen een specifiek kennisdomein van information security, bijvoorbeeld in information security management-processen, kwetsbaarheidsanalyses, pentesten, applicatiebeveiliging, privileged access management of encryptieoplossingen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met vulnerability scanning- en exposure managementoplossingen.
  • Je analyseert, optimaliseert en documenteert securityprocessen en governance op een gestructureerde manier.
  • Je beschikt over ervaring met securitybeheertechnieken en/of raamwerken zoals ISO 27000, COBIT for Security, NIST, OWASP en CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • Je kan technische bevindingen helder vertalen naar rapportering en aanbevelingen voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.
  • Je hebt ervaring met scripting en automatisering in Python en kan zelfstandig automatiseringsoplossingen opzetten en onderhouden.
  • Ervaring met ticketing- en workflowsystemen voor de opvolging van bevindingen en remediatieacties is vereist.
  • Relevante certificeringen binnen het expertisegebied, zoals CISM, CISSP of CEH, vormen een sterke meerwaarde.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met of ervaring in cyber awareness-programma's en phishingsimulaties.
  • Taalvereiste: Nederlandstalig op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

Je komt terecht in een context waarin een structurele dienstverlening voor digitale veiligheid verder wordt uitgebouwd. De technische omgeving is divers en omvat uiteenlopende technologieën, platformen, cloudomgevingen en architecturen. Daardoor is het belangrijk dat je zelfstandig kan werken, snel verbanden legt en automatisering doelgericht inzet.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).
