jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

About the Role:

As a Technical Program Manager, you will be a key player in our pre-sales and customer solutioning efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering to scope technical solutions that align with customer needs and drive Spreedly's growth. This is a customer-facing, consultative role focused on understanding prospect pain points and designing solutions that connect Spreedly's platform capabilities to business outcomes.
You will also influence revenue growth, shorten time-to-close, and accelerate value realization for our customers. As Spreedly scales, this role will shape our go-to-market infrastructure through solution templates, demo assets, and mentoring, making it an ideal opportunity for impact and professional growth.
This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with prospects and customers to identify needs and align use cases to Spreedly's capabilities
  • Deliver compelling demos, architecture diagrams, and documentation that support sales conversations and technical evaluation
  • Translate business and technical requirements into actionable solution proposals and implementation plans that support scalability and reuse
  • Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, solution artifacts, and objection handling templates
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to provide prospect feedback and ensure solution feasibility
  • Partner with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure smooth implementation handoffs
  • Serve as a technical expert in RFPs, security reviews, and compliance questionnaires
  • Educate internal teams on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and sales enablement materials

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Account Manager role within a B2B SaaS or fintech environment
  • Industry experience with eCommerce, PSPs, payment orchestration, or payment platforms
  • Background in payments, card-not-present commerce, fraud, or gateways preferred
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, SDKs, and system integration principles (especially REST and webhooks)
  • Familiarity with scripting or backend programming (Python, Ruby, or JavaScript a plus)
  • Experience collaborating with Sales and Product teams on enterprise deals
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including customer-facing documentation
  • Ability to simplify complex technical topics and guide customer decision-making

Additional Skills We Value:

  • Comfortable owning discovery and demo stages in an enterprise sales motion
  • Experience with implementation or support functions is a plus

We Offer Our US-Based Employees:

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid options
  • Company-paid Life and Disability insurance
  • Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly)
  • $1,000 annual professional development stipend
  • Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement
  • Access to company-paid professional coaching service
  • Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employees
Spreedly Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26

--
What It's Like to Work Here:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
--
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.
Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.
At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.
We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.
--

jobs.description:
Product Designer – UX/UI, Figma & Design Systems | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer to create intuitive, scalable, and visually polished digital experiences across web and mobile products.

This is not a purely visual UI design role. You’ll own the product design process from user research and UX flows through wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, design systems, and developer handoff.

You’ll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex workflows and create experiences that are functional, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.

If you combine strong UX thinking, UI craftsmanship, product problem-solving, and Figma expertise, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

User Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user interviews, usability tests, surveys, and product research
  • Identify user pain points, friction, and product improvement opportunities
  • Create:
    • Personas
    • Journey maps
    • User flows
    • Interaction models
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Hotjar
  • Translate research and product insights into actionable design decisions

UX Design & Product Flows

  • Design intuitive workflows across web and mobile products
  • Translate product requirements into:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
  • Simplify complex interactions into clear, easy-to-use experiences
  • Consider edge cases and different user states throughout the design process
  • Iterate quickly based on user, product, and stakeholder feedback

UI Design & Prototyping

  • Create polished, high-fidelity product interfaces using:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Design responsive experiences across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile
  • Establish clear:
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Interaction patterns
    • Micro-interactions
    • Interface consistency
  • Balance visual quality with usability and product functionality

Design Systems & Scalability

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems
  • Develop reusable component libraries
  • Define standards for:
    • Typography
    • Spacing
    • Color
    • Icons
    • Components
    • UI patterns
  • Maintain consistency across products and features
  • Improve collaboration between design and engineering through structured systems

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define requirements and priorities
  • Collaborate with engineers throughout implementation
  • Prepare developer-ready:
    • Designs
    • Assets
    • Specifications
    • Documentation
  • Use Figma Dev Mode or similar workflows for efficient handoff
  • Review implementations and help resolve design discrepancies
  • Support QA and refinement through development and release

Testing & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct usability reviews on existing and newly launched experiences
  • Gather user and stakeholder feedback after releases
  • Run or support A/B tests to validate design decisions
  • Analyze product performance and identify UX improvements
  • Continuously iterate to improve:
    • Usability
    • Engagement
    • Retention
    • Task completion

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional Product Design or UX/UI Design experience
  • Strong proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch
  • Experience designing responsive web and mobile products
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Interaction design
    • Usability
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and engineering teams
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and UX problem-solving, not just visual design
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS platforms
    • B2B products
    • Consumer applications
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with product analytics and experimentation tools such as:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Optimizely
    • Hotjar
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS or front-end development fundamentals
  • Experience working in Agile or sprint-based product teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Think about user problems before pixels
  • Can simplify complicated workflows into intuitive experiences
  • Balance user needs with business and technical requirements
  • Think in systems, components, and scalable patterns
  • Communicate and defend design decisions clearly
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers and engineers
  • Care about implementation quality, not just the Figma file
  • Move quickly while maintaining attention to detail

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review user behavior and identify UX opportunities
  • Map user journeys and product flows
  • Create wireframes and interactive prototypes
  • Design polished interfaces in Figma
  • Review requirements with Product Managers
  • Collaborate with engineers on implementation details
  • Review builds and resolve UX/UI inconsistencies
  • Maintain reusable components and design systems
  • Conduct usability testing and analyze feedback
  • Iterate on existing features based on user and product data

In short: you turn product ideas and user problems into intuitive, scalable, and polished digital experiences that people can use effortlessly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and task completion rates
  • Increased user engagement and retention
  • Design system consistency and adoption
  • On-time delivery of designs and prototypes
  • Reduced design-related implementation rework
  • Successful product and engineering handoffs
  • Positive user and stakeholder feedback

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own the complete product design lifecycle
  • Work directly with product and engineering teams
  • Solve meaningful UX and workflow challenges
  • Influence both product experience and design systems
  • Design across web and mobile environments
  • High ownership in a remote product environment
  • Opportunity to grow into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • UX Lead
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Task
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have a strong Product Design or UX/UI portfolio
  • Enjoy solving complex user and workflow problems
  • Are highly proficient in Figma and modern product design practices
  • Think beyond visual design and understand the complete user experience
  • Enjoy collaborating closely with product and engineering teams

We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build intuitive, scalable digital products that deliver exceptional user experiences.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with product design, UX/UI, Figma, user research, prototyping, design systems, and collaborating with product and engineering teams.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.title: Health Coach (Dietitian/Nutritionist) - Specialist Weight Management, Remote
jobs.excerpt: Full-Time | Fully Remote | Some Evening and Weekend Working Required | Fixed-Term Contract We're looking for an HCPC-registered Dietitian or AfN-registered Nutritionist to join our growing clinical team at one of the UK's most exciting health-tech companies.
jobs.description:
Full-Time | Fully Remote | Some Evening and Weekend Working Required | Fixed-Term Contract

We're looking for an HCPC-registered Dietitian or AfN-registered Nutritionist to join our growing clinical team at one of the UK's most exciting health-tech companies.

In this role, you'll support people living with obesity to make sustainable lifestyle and behaviour changes, working as part of a multidisciplinary team within our Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS).

This is a fully remote role: all delivery is via video consultation and in-app messaging, and you can be based anywhere in the UK. Flexibility is required to support some early evenings and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

The Challenge

More than 1 in 4 adults in the UK are living with obesity; a chronic condition that often negatively impacts their physical and mental health, and therefore quality of life. Access to specialist weight management services for the treatment of obesity remains limited and varies geographically due to a lack of funding. Existing services face long waiting lists, resulting in treatment delays which can adversely affect patient outcomes.

Enter Second Nature...

By bringing together the latest behavioural science, psychology, technology, and the talents of our incredible team, our mission is to eradicate obesity and type 2 diabetes for all, and as part of that mission, we are aiming to increase access to effective treatment for people living with obesity. Second Nature provides specialist weight management services to support people living with obesity.

About us:

  • We've positively changed the lives of 300,000+ people through accessible, evidence-based healthcare.
  • We're rated 'Excellent' on Trustpilot by over 8,000 of our members.
  • We're the UK’s largest digital health provider to the NHS
  • We're a leading B2C provider of GLP-1 medication-assisted weight loss programmes, and 1 of 5 NICE-approved providers to deliver these services within the NHS in the future
  • Our team members stay with us for an average of 4.3 years

The Role

We're looking for a dynamic Health Coach who is passionate about making a positive difference to those living with obesity to grow our current clinical team. You will be part of an innovative Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS) that uses a multi-disciplinary team (MDT) approach to obesity treatment and technology to optimise patient engagement and outcomes. Our MDT includes doctors, dietitians, psychologists and physical activity specialists, all with special interests in obesity.

You will provide nutritional and lifestyle interventions to people living with obesity to support them to make sustainable dietary and behaviour changes, in collaboration with the MDT. You'll be using evidence-based health coaching techniques, such as motivational interviewing, goal setting and behaviour change frameworks. Whilst it is important to be able to work autonomously, you will receive comprehensive training. You will also have access to clinical supervision and support from senior clinicians.

This post is full-time (40 hours/week) and fixed-term, with flexible hours and a view to extend based on the needs of the service. You'll work fully remotely, connecting with service users through video consultations and in-app messaging. The role requires working some early evenings per week and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

What you'll do:

  • Independently implement appropriate initial assessment methods to allocate service users to the most suitable treatment pathway
  • Deliver group-based and one-to-one nutritional and lifestyle interventions remotely via video calls, to support changes in dietary and physical activity behaviours
  • Provide ongoing coaching and support between sessions through in-app messaging
  • Support service users across both medicated and non-medicated programmes, including those accessing GLP-1 medication
  • Attend regular MDT meetings to monitor the care of our service users
  • Attend clinical supervision to discuss complex or high-risk cases
  • Appropriately manage clinical risk (e.g. safeguarding concerns) when it arises during clinical practice
  • Maintain adequate CPD, receive regular clinical supervision in accordance with good practice guidelines and continue to meet your registration requirements (HCPC or AfN)
  • Maintain confidentiality of information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act and ensuring that participant confidentiality is protected at all times
  • Contribute to innovation projects, service evaluation, and ongoing programme development at Second Nature

Requirements

You have experience working in a weight management/bariatric/eating disorder setting

  • A qualified HCPC-registered Dietitian or AfN-registered Nutritionist with experience of weight management and/or bariatric experience, or working with patients in an eating disorder setting
  • Proven experience delivering group-based programmes, with the confidence to facilitate sessions effectively in a digital setting
  • A solid understanding of obesity as a condition and the issues many people living with obesity face, including weight stigma
  • Experience or training in health coaching, behaviour change, or motivational interviewing, with awareness of coaching models and approaches
  • Able to provide supportive, empathetic patient-centred care to patients who may have complex physical and mental health needs

You're comfortable working fully remotely

  • You enjoy remote working and can stay motivated and organised without an office around you
  • You have a suitable home working setup, including a private space for confidential consultations and a reliable internet connection

You can work autonomously and collaboratively with a doctor-led multidisciplinary team (MDT) to oversee patient care

  • You'll confidently and independently manage a caseload of service users, delivering nutritional and lifestyle interventions via video calls and in-app messaging, and working collaboratively with our MDT

You have experience in supporting the coordination of a healthcare service

  • You have experience in monitoring and supporting patients' journeys through a service in line with an organisation's protocols, including scheduling assessments and appointments, monitoring attendance rates and following up with patients, writing GP letters, and revising protocols
  • You have experience using Excel or Google Sheets (or other similar programmes) to monitor patients' journeys

You are dynamic and have a strong drive to work in healthcare tech

  • You have experience thriving in fast-paced environments and are energised by the dynamic nature of start-up life, where being hands-on and adaptable to the evolving needs of the service is essential
  • You're confident in using technology to provide patient care, including recording and reviewing patient notes, and providing in-app coaching
  • Excited by digital initiatives that increase access to healthcare

Education/Qualifications:

  • HCPC registration as a Dietitian, or AfN registration as a Nutritionist (Registered Nutritionist or Registered Associate Nutritionist)
  • Relevant degree in Dietetics, Nutrition or a related field

To apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter via this application page, and include your HCPC or AfN registration number. Unfortunately, we're unable to progress applications without appropriate registration. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to respond to everyone individually. If we don't have a chance to get back to you, we're not intentionally being rude, but please assume it's a no for now!

Benefits

  • Work from home with flexible hours
  • Joining a culture of intelligent, friendly, and highly-motivated individuals who are passionate about what they do
  • A competitive market salary
  • 25 days of holiday plus national holidays

jobs.description:
Our Story:
Crisis Prevention Institute Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence-based de-escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people within service-oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long-term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.

At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe the power of empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. It’s a philosophy that is central to everything we do, and traces back to our beginning.

As a member of the team, you can expect to:

  • Make a difference through your work – You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends about what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience only obtained within a fast-growing organization.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun – We work hard but make the time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate the wins.

Position Summary

The Business Development Representative – Small Business converts marketing‑generated Scheduled Consultation Leads (SCLs) into qualified sales conversations through timely outreach, effective qualification, and accurate routing. This role manages a high‑volume flow of inbound and lightly outbound leads, focusing on speed‑to‑contact, consistent engagement, and disciplined lead management. The BDR assesses initial customer needs, determines the correct sales owner using established segmentation and account rules, and schedules qualified appointments for Small Business Account Executives. The role emphasizes repeatable processes, strong communication, and efficient digital engagement to drive lead conversion and support Small Business revenue growth.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Conduct timely, persistent outreach to assigned SCLs across phone, email, and approved channels, meeting speed‑to‑contact expectations.
  • Qualify leads to understand initial customer needs, sales readiness, and appropriate next steps.
  • Apply segmentation and account ownership rules to determine the correct sales owner and route leads accurately.
  • Schedule qualified Small Business appointments and provide clear customer context to support effective handoffs.
  • Maintain disciplined CRM practices, including accurate activity tracking, qualification notes, routing decisions, and dispositions.
  • Meet or exceed expectations for lead engagement, qualification quality, appointment creation, and other defined BDR performance metrics.
  • Partner with Small Business Account Executives, Sales teams, and Marketing to share insights on lead quality, customer trends, and conversion opportunities.
  • Maintain working knowledge of CPI solutions, customer segments, and sales ownership rules to effectively engage prospects and determine the correct sales path.

Performance Metrics

  • Speed‑to‑contact and lead engagement consistency.
  • Volume and quality of qualified Small Business appointments.
  • Lead qualification accuracy and routing compliance.
  • CRM accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Conversion rates from SCL to qualified appointment.
  • Collaboration effectiveness with Small Business Account Executives and Marketing.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 1+ years in business development, sales development, inside sales, customer engagement, or similar roles preferred.
  • Experience conducting outbound phone and email outreach in a professional environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, ask thoughtful questions, and identify initial customer needs.
  • Experience working in a high‑volume, activity‑driven environment with defined performance expectations.
  • CRM and sales engagement tool proficiency for managing leads, activities, and dispositions.
  • Strong communication, organization, time management, and follow‑up skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with marketing‑generated leads in a B2B sales environment.
  • Experience in a BDR/SDR‑to‑Account Executive sales model.
  • Experience in education, healthcare, human services, training, or similar markets.

Work Environment

Standard office or remote‑work environment. Some travel may be required based on business needs.

What We Offer:

  • $60,000 OTE
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave

Ovation Law Firm is a fast-growing, consumer-focused law firm committed to delivering exceptional legal services while fostering a high-performance, accountable, and supportive workplace. We work closely with partner legal teams to connect injured individuals with the legal support they need, and our intake team plays a critical role in setting the tone for every client relationship.

About the Role

We are seeking a high-energy, empathetic, and motivated Legal Intake Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

In this role, your goal is to listen, qualify, and warmly introduce potential clients to our partner legal teams using an assumptive, sales-minded approach. You will guide callers through the early stages of their legal journey with confidence, compassion, and urgency, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and ready for the next step.

This is a fast-paced position well-suited for individuals with backgrounds in legal intake, sales, customer service, call centers, or customer acquisition of any kind, who thrive in high-volume environments and know how to balance empathy with performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to incoming inquiries via phone, web forms, and chat in real time, providing rapid, attentive support to individuals seeking legal help after an injury.

  • Apply proprietary scripts and strict qualification criteria to quickly determine whether a case is a fit for partner legal teams.
  • Use an assumptive, sales-minded approach to perform live warm transfers to our partner legal teams or schedule timely callbacks for qualified leads.
  • Accurately document all caller information, case details, and outcomes in Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
  • Manage follow-ups for pending leads, maintaining an organized pipeline and re-engaging prospects who were not ready to proceed on initial contact.

Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills (C1 level), both verbal and written.

  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with the ability to mirror a caller’s tone, demonstrate empathy, and build rapport quickly.
  • Sales-minded approach focused on educating callers and guiding them toward taking action on their personal injury matter.

Nice-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • 10 paid time-off (PTO) days per year.

Who are Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

The Role

This is a hands-on Account Executive role accountable for winning new customers for Evotix's environment, health and safety and operational risk software within a defined EMEA territory. 

You will own your territory, build and progress a high-quality pipeline, lead sales campaigns and close multi-year subscription agreements. Success will require a strong new business mindset, disciplined account planning, credible executive engagement and reliable forecasting. 

You will work closely with Business Development, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Bids and Tenders, Professional Services and regional sales leadership, ensuring each successful sale moves smoothly into implementation, account management and support.

What You'll Do

Territory, Pipeline & New Business

  • Build and execute a focused territory plan, balancing both short and long term objectives for your territory and Evotix.
  • Create your own pipeline through disciplined prospecting, account development, networking, referrals and effective use of Evotix sales technology. 
  • Qualify and progress opportunities using the Sales playbook and agreed sales methodology, maintaining clear next steps and commercial momentum. 
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from first engagement through negotiation and close.

Commercial & Executive Selling

  • Deliver compelling presentations and business cases that connect Evotix’s differentiation to each customer’s operational and commercial priorities. 
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives and leaders across safety, compliance, operations, technology and procurement. 
  • Translate software capabilities into a clear customer value case and measurable business outcomes. 
  • Own high-quality responses to requests for information and proposals for well-qualified opportunities.

Sales Discipline & Collaboration

  • Maintain accurate account, pipeline and opportunity data in Salesforce, including timely updates and dependable monthly forecasts. 
  • Partner with Business Development, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Bids and Tenders, Professional Services and regional sales leadership to deploy the right support at the right time. 
  • Represent Evotix credibly at industry events, conferences and professional networks, bringing market insight and customer feedback back into the business. 
  • Complete a professional handover of closed customers to implementation, account management and support teams.

What You Bring

Essential

  • History of success winning new business in SaaS. 
  • Experience selling multi-year subscription solutions through sales cycles.
  • Demonstrable ability to build pipeline independently of inbound or Business Development leads. 
  • Strong commercial judgement, deal discipline and confidence selling value to senior executives. 
  • Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation and written communication skills. 
  • Strong territory, account and opportunity management, with a consistent approach to forecasting and customer relationship development. 

Desirable

  • Experience selling environment, health and safety, operational risk or other regulated-industry software. 
  • Experience in a fast-paced, scaling organisation.

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

jobs.description:
Project Manager, Client Onboarding

CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full-time · Travel to client sites (~25–40%)

Compensation: $95,000 – $120,000 base, depending on experience + performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.

About CrelioHealth

CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow — from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory — for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.

The Role

When a lab signs with CrelioHealth, you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.

This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location — and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.

What You Will DoOwn implementations

  • Lead onboarding projects for new US clients — single-site labs through multi-location networks — from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.
  • Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.
  • Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.
  • Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training — roughly 25–40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.

Make clients successful

  • Train lab staff on real workflows — accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal — and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.
  • Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.
  • Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.

Champion the platform

  • Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently — to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.
  • Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team — with incentives for you when they close.
  • Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

What We Are Looking For (Must-haves)

  • 4–7 years of project management experience, with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.
  • Healthcare experience is required; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred — as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).
  • Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.
  • Excellent presenter and communicator — comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.
  • Structured and self-managing: you can run multiple concurrent onboardings remotely without anyone chasing you.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites across the US; valid driver’s license and authorization to work in the United States.

Nice-to-haves

  • Direct experience with an LIS/LIMS migration or go-live (any vendor).
  • Familiarity with HL7v2 / FHIR interfaces, lab billing/RCM basics, or instrument middleware.
  • Experience in customer success, solutions consulting, or pre-sales — anywhere you have had to win people over, not just manage tasks.
  • PMP, CAPM, or Lean Six Sigma is welcome but not required — we care more about go-lives you have shipped than certificates you hold.
  • Comfort using modern AI tools to work faster (drafting plans, summarizing calls, preparing training material) — with the judgment to know what still needs a human.

How We Hire

We know polished resumes and cover letters are easy to generate these days, so our process is built around watching you work rather than reading about it. After a screening call, you will do a live onboarding simulation based on a realistic lab scenario, and a short role-play where you present CrelioHealth to a (friendly but skeptical) “lab director.” No trick questions, no take-home busywork — just the actual job, compressed. We will respect your time and give you a decision quickly.

The Fine Print

CrelioHealth Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

The salary range above is a good-faith estimate for this posting and may vary based on experience, skills, and location within the US.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

The National Senior Characterization Analyst provides leadership for the acquisition, stewardship, analysis, and reporting of material characterization data across CAA states. This role establishes and maintains national standards for data quality, consistency, and comparability, ensuring characterization datasets support organizational reporting, strategic planning, and program evaluation. As the primary authority on characterization data governance, the position oversees the integrity and long-term usability of data generated through CAA characterization studies. The Senior Analyst will be on the Collection & Processing team within the Material Services department of Program Planning and Operations (PPO), which also includes Data & Analytics, Compliance & Regulatory Affairs, and Emerging States.

This position leads the development and maintenance of sort category frameworks across states, including the alignment of study-specific sort categories with state reporting requirements. The role evaluates waste characterization studies conducted by states and local jurisdictions to assess methodological alignment and opportunities for integration into CAA programs. The National Senior Characterization Analyst provides strategic oversight and guidance to CAA state teams to address data quality concerns, promote standardized practices, and ensure consistency with both national objectives and state-specific requirements.

In partnership with the CAA Data & Analytics team, this role oversees the integration of characterization data into enterprise data structures and analytical frameworks, ensuring data assets effectively support organizational reporting and decision-making needs. The position is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving standard operating procedures related to data intake, quality assurance and quality control, data management, and long-term data governance, reinforcing accountability, consistency, and data integrity across characterization programs.

Key Responsibilities

Data Intake & Management

  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of processes governing the intake and integration of waste characterization datasets, including new studies, legacy datasets, third-party data, and state-generated studies.
  • Oversee data quality assurance activities, including the standardization, validation, and preparation of characterization data for incorporation into CAA systems and analytical platforms.
  • Establish and maintain standards for metadata management, documentation, dataset assumptions, and version control to ensure transparency, consistency, and long-term data integrity.

Category Definitions & Study Alignment

  • Lead the development, implementation, and ongoing refinement of national sort category frameworks, ensuring consistent application across CAA programs, state initiatives, and pilot studies.
  • Provide oversight of category mapping methodologies, addressing state-specific reporting requirements, category discrepancies, and study-level variations to maintain data comparability and analytical consistency.
  • Evaluate state and local waste characterization studies to assess methodological alignment, data suitability, and opportunities for integration into CAA characterization programs and reporting efforts.

Analysis, Metrics, and Reporting

  • Provide leadership for the development and application of analytical methodologies used to calculate key CAA performance metrics, including contamination, capture, and recycling rates, leveraging validated characterization datasets.
  • Direct comparative and trend analyses to identify emerging patterns, support cross-state benchmarking, and inform programmatic decision-making.
  • Oversee the development of analytical summaries, data visualizations, and reporting deliverables that support internal stakeholders, strategic initiatives, and external reporting requirements.

QA/QC, Systems Coordination, & SOPs

  • Establish and maintain QA/QC frameworks, validation standards, and acceptance criteria to ensure the defensibility, consistency, and reliability of characterization datasets across studies.

The engineer in this role is responsible for the full development lifecycle across the entire portfolio: architecture, implementation, testing, packaging, build pipelines, and release.

The team's solutions must run reliably across a wide range of host operating systems and hypervisors - Linux, Windows, AIX, Solaris, VMware ESX/vCenter, Hyper-V, and Oracle Linux VM - as well as Podman-containerized deployments and Ansible-automated workflows.

If you want to own a meaningful portfolio end-to-end with minimal hand-holding, this role delivers that.

Responsibilities

Core Development

  • Design, implement, and maintain Python CLI tools (AADM, SnapSync) and their shared domain libraries
  • Develop and extend the Infinidat Ansible Collection modules covering InfiniBox volumes, hosts, clusters, exports, snapshots, network spaces, and more
  • Maintain and evolve the IPAT performance alerting service, deployed as a Podman-managed containerized application
  • Extend host and hypervisor integration across Linux, Windows, AIX, Solaris, VMware ESX/vCenter, Hyper-V, and Oracle Linux VM
  • Maintain InfiniBox and InfiniMetrics REST API and InfiniSDK integrations across the portfolio
  • Build and improve AI-assisted exception triage pipelines (AADM, SnapSync)

Build, Packaging, and Release

  • Own multi-distribution build systems: Docker-based builder containers, RPM and DEB packaging for RHEL, Rocky, Oracle Linux, and Ubuntu - Maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines and release tooling across all projects
  • Manage release cycles: tag, validate, and promote builds through unstable → stable → external channels
  • Publish Ansible Collection releases to Ansible Galaxy and the internal GitLab registry

Quality and Reliability

  • Design and maintain unit and acceptance test suites
  • Investigate and root-cause field exceptions; own the triage-to-fix lifecycle

Process and Operations

  • Maintain Jira workflow and release notes across the portfolio
  • Keep technical documentation current as tools evolve

Requirements

  • At least 7 years of Python development with a focus on systems or CLI tooling - not web frameworks
  • Demonstrated enterprise storage background: block storage, NAS, replication, host connectivity via FC or iSCSI
  • Strong Linux systems proficiency across multiple distributions (RHEL/Rocky, Ubuntu); direct experience building and publishing RPM and DEB packages

  • Container-based build and deployment experience (Docker and/or Podman)

  • Hypervisor integration experience: VMware ESX/vCenter (pyvmomi), Hyper-V, or Oracle Linux VM

  • SQLAlchemy or similar Python ORM
  • AI-assisted tooling integration
  • Experience with Podman quadlets and systemd service management

Infinidat’s enterprise storage portfolio provides global Fortune 500 enterprises and service providers with best-in-class solutions for primary storage, next-generation data protection, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience. Infinidat’s acclaimed InfuzeOS is the one of the most flexible and complete enterprise software-defined storage architectures in the industry. We recently announced powerful enhancements, an extensive expansion, and the dynamic evolution of our award-winning G4 enterprise cyber and AI storage solutions! DuploCloud is an AI-native DevOps automation platform that delivers the AI DevOps Engineer, an always-on teammate that builds, secures, and manages cloud infrastructure. Instead of relying on scripts and fragmented tooling, DuploCloud uses agentic AI to execute real operational tasks across provisioning, compliance, Kubernetes, observability, and cost optimization.

As Senior Compensation Analyst, you own the day-to-day technical execution of Boldr's global compensation programmes and serve as the primary backup point of contact for the Senior Manager, Total Rewards on compensation operations. You are the team's deepest technical expert on job evaluation, market benchmarking, job architecture, and salary banding, and the first point of contact for compensation matters when the Senior Manager is unavailable.

jobs.excerpt: What is PerfectServe?  PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space.
jobs.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Role Overview

PerfectServe is seeking a Director of Product Management – AI to own the product vision, strategy, and lifecycle of our AI-native answering service platform. This is a modern product leadership role: you will define what gets built and why, ground every decision in deep customer and clinical understanding, and move fast using the tools of contemporary product development — including AI-assisted prototyping, rapid experimentation, and data-driven iteration.

You are technically fluent enough to engage meaningfully with engineering architecture, evaluate AI capabilities critically, and prototype ideas yourself — but your primary orientation is toward the customer, the clinical workflow, and the business outcome. Reporting to the Sr Director, Product Management, you will be the connective tissue between healthcare operations teams, engineering, and executive leadership, translating complex clinical and interoperability needs into a clear, prioritized, and continuously evolving product roadmap.

Core Responsibilities

AI Product Vision & Roadmap Ownership

  • Define and own the product strategy for PerfectServe’s AI answering service, including near-term delivery commitments and a longer-horizon vision for how AI evolves across the portfolio.
  • Translate business objectives and clinical workflows into a prioritized, clearly reasoned product roadmap — and maintain it as a living document that reflects new information, not a static plan.
  • Partner with the CTO and Director of Software Engineering to align roadmap sequencing with technical capacity, architecture constraints, and infrastructure investments.
  • Make and communicate clear product tradeoff decisions: what is in scope, what is deferred, and why.

Customer & Clinical Discovery

  • Lead ongoing customer discovery efforts: conduct interviews, site visits (virtual or in-person), and workflow observation sessions with clinical and administrative end users.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of how healthcare organizations use answering services, operator consoles, and AI-augmented communication — including the pain points, workarounds, and compliance constraints that matter most.
  • Synthesize input from cross-functional teams, market and customers into product insights; distinguish signal from noise when stakeholder demands conflict.
  • Define user personas and jobs-to-be-done for the AI platform’s primary audiences: clinical staff, contact center agents, patients, and healthcare administrators.

AI-Native Product Development Practices

  • Use modern AI tools to accelerate your own product work: generate prototypes and wireframes, run rapid concept tests, and explore technical feasibility before committing engineering resources.
  • Design and run structured product experiments — A/B tests, pilot programs, shadow deployments — to validate hypotheses before broad rollout.
  • Define clear acceptance criteria and success metrics for every feature, including AI-specific measures such as containment rate, deflection accuracy, latency, and user-perceived quality.
  • Actively evaluate emerging AI capabilities (new LLMs, voice models, orchestration frameworks) and recommend adoption decisions based on product value and technical fit, not novelty.

Healthcare Interoperability & Workflow Expertise

  • Apply working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards — HL7, FHIR, and API integration patterns — to shape AI feature design and integration requirements.
  • Ensure AI features are designed with clinical workflow reality in mind: how nurses, physicians, schedulers, and operators interact with systems under time pressure.
  • Identify and manage product-level compliance and safety considerations including HIPAA, minimum necessary data principles, and the appropriate use of AI in clinical decision-adjacent contexts.
  • Collaborate with Clinical and Operations teams to ensure AI behavior aligns with care protocols, escalation paths, and patient safety standards.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Delivery

  • Own the relationship between product requirements and engineering delivery — writing precise, well-scoped specifications that reduce ambiguity without over-constraining implementation.
  • Serve as the product accountability owner for the outsourced development partner, reviewing deliverables against acceptance criteria and escalating quality issues promptly.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market sequencing for new AI features, including packaging, positioning, and customer communication.
  • Represent the product perspective in executive conversations; communicate roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and AI adoption risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Metrics, Learning & Continuous Improvement

  • Define the measurement framework for AI product performance: establish baselines, set targets, and drive quarterly reviews of key metrics with engineering and executive leadership.
  • Build a culture of learning from production data: use real-world call outcomes, error logs, and user feedback to continuously improve AI model performance and product design.
  • Identify and act on leading indicators of customer churn or dissatisfaction related to AI feature quality.

Team Leadership

  • Initially operate as an individual contributor; build out a product and design team as the platform and organization scale.
  • Establish PM practices and norms that support AI-native development: lightweight documentation, fast feedback loops, and outcome-oriented delivery measurement.
  • Mentor and develop junior product team members as the function grows.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years owning AI, NLP, or conversational AI products in production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead customer discovery in complex B2B environments; experience interviewing clinical or operational end users is a strong differentiator.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards: HL7 v2, FHIR, and API integration patterns. Able to engage in technical interoperability discussions without an engineer in the room.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and the product design considerations it requires: data minimization, audit trails, access controls, and PHI handling.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to evaluate AI capabilities critically, write clear functional specifications, and prototype concepts using no-code or AI-assisted tools.

Preferred

Why This Role

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for an experienced Staff Engineer to play a key role in shaping the future of software delivery at LaunchDarkly at the intersection of Releases and Observability on the Guardian team. In a world where agents are delivering code faster and more reliably, releasing safely is no longer optional infrastructure; it’s a competitive advantage. The Guardian team is focused on making every release safer, faster, and more reliable. Our mission is to redefine how software is released: automating release processes, measuring the real-time impact of feature rollouts, and simplifying debugging when things go wrong. From automated release pipelines to metrics monitoring, error tracking, and fully automated rollbacks, our work ensures every code change is measured, and the entire release process from rollout to issue mitigation is managed for maximum efficiency and reliability.

We are solving critical challenges in modern software delivery: reducing the time it takes to detect regressions, automating responses to minimize risk, and eliminating manual effort. We extensively use the products we build, allowing us to create our own ideal release process while shaping the developer experience for teams across the industry.

If you’re interested in building the systems that help software teams ship safely at scale, we’d love to work with you.

Responsibilities:

  • Prototyping / 0-to-1 innovation, lead the exploration and prototyping of new product concepts at the intersection of feature flags and observability, from integrations to new implementations. You'll operate with high autonomy to identify opportunities, rapidly validate ideas through proof of concepts, and define the technical direction for net-new product areas that expand Guardian's value.

  • Observability domain expertise and thought leadership, bring deep domain expertise in observability systems and apply it to reimagine how engineering teams understand the real-time impact of software changes. You'll serve as the team's resident expert on the evolving observability landscape, translating industry trends and customer pain points into concrete product prototypes that differentiate Guardian in the market.

  • Collaborate seamlessly with cross-functional partners (product, design, data science, and engineering) to architect and advance our observability products. Leverage your broad experience to facilitate strategic discussions that align technical solutions with business goals, ensuring the delivery of scalable and effective features.

  • Stay at the forefront of development trends, observability, and data-driven product evolution, bringing deep expertise to suggest and implement forward-thinking improvements in tools, processes, and methodologies. Your proactive involvement in continuous learning and improvement will help ensure the team remains competitive and cutting-edge in its approach to building user-focused products.

  • Proactively identify opportunities for product and user experience improvements, leveraging data insights and feedback to propose innovative, well-reasoned solutions. Lead the implementation of these enhancements, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility, ensuring each change drives meaningful improvements in engagement and performance.

Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production-quality full-stack features

  • Experience with observability systems, statistical analysis pipelines, and event-based metrics infrastructure.

  • Strong architectural understanding of data platforms, backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Experience leading 0-to-1 product development, taking ambiguous problem spaces from exploration through proof of concept to validated direction.

  • Deep familiarity with the observability ecosystem (APM, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, error tracking) and an informed perspective on where it's heading.

jobs.title: VP, Patient Engagement & Recruitment
jobs.excerpt: About Profound Research Profound Research partners with community physicians to offer clinical trials as a therapeutic option for their patients.
jobs.description:
About Profound Research

Profound Research partners with community physicians to offer clinical trials as a therapeutic option for their patients. We handle all infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative operations so physicians can focus on patient care. Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship.

Our Mission:Improving lives by providing advanced therapeutic options

Our Vision:Creating the absolute best patient-physician experience in clinical research

Our Values:

  • Compassion:We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered

  • Urgency: We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues

  • Solution Orientation: We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency

  • Excellence: We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards

Why This Role Exists

Patients are at the center of everything Profound does, and patient recruitment is one of the most direct ways we deliver on our mission of expanding access to advanced therapeutic options.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a senior leader to own and scale our patient engagement and recruitment function across our national site network. This leader will shape the strategy, team, processes, and operating model that help connect the right patients to the right trials faster while preserving the personal, trusted experience that defines Profound.

Today, most of our patient recruiters are embedded within site teams, with a smaller centralized team providing additional support. This role will help evolve how those models work together as we scale, bringing clinical research experience, strong people leadership, and creative problem solving to how we recruit, engage, and support patients.

This is a hands-on builder role for someone who is energized by growth, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to create a patient recruitment function that is both highly effective and deeply patient-centered.

What You’ll Own

Patient Recruitment Strategy & Operating Model

  • Own Profound’s patient engagement and recruitment strategy across sites, studies, and therapeutic areas

  • Lead the continued evolution of Profound’s recruitment operating model, including embedded, centralized, and hybrid support, to improve enrollment performance and patient experience as we scale

  • Build scalable approaches to patient identification, outreach, engagement, pre-screening, scheduling, and retention in partnership with Clinical Operations

  • Establish clear priorities, goals, and accountability structures for the patient recruitment function

  • Translate organizational growth goals, study needs, and site realities into practical recruitment strategies

  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Commercial, Study Startup, Quality, Clinical Systems, Finance, and People to ensure recruitment strategies are aligned, compliant, and executable

Enrollment Performance & Functional Execution

  • Own recruitment performance across the patient funnel, including lead quality, outreach effectiveness, pre-screening, scheduling, show rates, screening conversion, enrollment outcomes, and retention support

  • Establish the KPIs, dashboards, reporting rhythms, and forecasting needed to create visibility into recruitment performance

  • Use data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and resourcing needs across the function

  • Lead study- and site-level recruitment planning for priority trials, ensuring the right strategies and resources are in place to support enrollment goals

  • Bring structure and urgency to recruitment execution while maintaining flexibility for the needs of different studies, sites, and patient populations

Patient Engagement & Experience

  • Ensure Profound’s recruitment practices reflect a compassionate, service-oriented, and patient-centered experience

  • Strengthen the patient journey from initial engagement through screening and enrollment in partnership with Clinical Operations

  • Develop approaches that expand access to clinical research for diverse patient populations and support community-based recruitment

  • Identify opportunities to improve patient communication, follow-up, and retention without creating unnecessary complexity for sites or patients

Team Leadership & Function Building

  • Lead and develop Profound’s patient recruitment team, including embedded and centralized team members

  • Build a high-performing culture rooted in accountability, urgency, collaboration, compassion, and continuous improvement

  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and career pathways within the patient recruitment function

  • Build the team structure, leadership capabilities, staffing plans, and ways of working needed to support continued growth

  • Coach and develop leaders and team members to strengthen recruitment execution, patient communication, problem solving, and cross-functional partnership

Process, Technology, & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the recruitment process and technology roadmap in partnership with Clinical Systems, IT, and operational leaders

  • Identify opportunities to improve consistency, visibility, efficiency, and scalability across recruitment workflows

  • Evaluate and implement tools, systems, vendor partnerships, and digital engagement strategies that improve recruitment performance and patient experience

  • Ensure recruitment processes remain compliant with clinical research, privacy, IRB, and patient communication requirements

  • Lead change management related to recruitment processes, technology, operating model, and performance expectations

Requirements

Essential Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare administration, public health, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may also be considered

  • Meaningful experience in clinical research, patient recruitment, clinical operations, healthcare operations, or a closely related environment

  • Experience supporting or leading patient recruitment, enrollment, patient engagement, pre-screening, or site-level clinical research operations

  • Practical understanding of how patients move through the clinical trial recruitment process, including outreach, pre-screening, scheduling, screening, enrollment, and retention

  • Experience leading teams, projects, or cross-functional initiatives in a growing, multi-site, remote, or geographically dispersed environment

  • Strong people leadership skills, including the ability to coach, develop, motivate, and hold teams accountable

  • Ability to use data, site feedback, and operational insights to identify opportunities and improve performance

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to build trust across clinical, operational, commercial, technology, finance, and people teams

  • Working knowledge of clinical research compliance considerations, including patient privacy, IRB-approved recruitment materials, GCP principles, and ethical patient engagement

  • Strong communication skills, sound judgment, initiative, and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a clinical research site network, SMO, CRO, sponsor, healthcare services organization, or community-based research environment

  • Experience with embedded, centralized, or hybrid patient recruitment models

  • Prior experience working directly with patients or in a patient-facing clinical research, healthcare, or recruitment capacity

  • Experience leading patient recruiters, patient engagement specialists, call center teams, clinical research staff, or other patient-facing operational teams

  • Experience with recruitment technology, CRM platforms, contact center tools, scheduling systems, patient engagement platforms, or clinical trial recruitment vendors

  • Experience developing or using KPIs, dashboards, productivity expectations, or capacity planning tools

  • Knowledge of digital recruitment, community outreach, physician referral workflows, patient databases, or other patient acquisition strategies

  • Experience supporting growth, change, or function-building in a startup or high-growth environment

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • This role is primarily performed in a remote/office environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk, working on a computer, and participating in virtual meetings
  • Requires the ability to communicate clearly in verbal and written forms and to read and interpret detailed materials
  • Minimal travel to company sites, meetings, or partner locations may be required, including the ability to navigate office/clinical environments and transport typical work materials
  • Must be able to maintain a productive and professional remote work setup with reliable internet connectivity
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role

Why Join Profound Research?

  • Meaningful Impact: Every role at Profound contributes to advancing medical knowledge and expanding therapeutic options for patients – the work we do here matters
  • Professional Growth: We invest in our people through comprehensive training, certification support, and ongoing education to help you grow in your role and your career
  • Leadership & Advancement: Profound is a place where initiative is recognized. We actively support internal growth and create pathways for people to take on greater responsibility over time
  • Collaborative Culture: You’ll work alongside a team of dedicated professionals who are passionate about clinical research and committed to doing it well
  • Full Benefits Package: Competitive compensation, health insurance, PTO, retirement plan, and professional development support
  • Broad Organizational Exposure: Gain visibility across the full lifecycle of clinical research – from study startup through closeout – working cross-functionally with clinical, finance, and operations teams
  • Flexible Work Environment: This role offers the autonomy of a remote or hybrid work setting while keeping you connected to a team that’s deeply collaborative and mission-driven

jobs.description:
Intelex is seeking an experienced Product Designer to help shape intuitive, effective digital experiences for organizations working to protect people and the environment. In this role, you will design end-to-end workflows for complex web and mobile applications and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and researchers. You will use customer insights, industry knowledge, and strong interaction design skills to create solutions that are practical, easy to use, and aligned to real user goals.

We are looking for a designer who is comfortable working in a dynamic, collaborative environment and who can translate research, product insights, customer usage data, and configuration patterns into clear, thoughtful design outcomes. They are comfortable using quantitative signals to uncover opportunities, inform design decisions, and generate hypotheses that can be explored and validated through the design process. This person values learning over perfection in the early stages of design, uses rapid experimentation to reduce risk and validate assumptions, and leverages AI as a natural part of their design workflow. They are equally comfortable contributing to individual product experiences and strengthening the systems, patterns, and design foundations that support them.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

  • Apply user-centered design principles, customer insights, and product usage data to understand problems, form hypotheses, and guide product direction

  • Translate user goals and real-world scenarios into clear workflows and interface designs

  • Design scalable solutions that consider the broader product ecosystem, shared components, and system dependencies

  • Conduct or support user research, synthesize findings, and ensure they inform design decisions

  • Create and iterate on user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile, using low-fidelity exploration and rapid experimentation to validate ideas before investing in detailed design

  • Validate concepts and designs through testing, experimentation, and analysis of user behavior, incorporating feedback and evidence into iterative improvements

  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering throughout discovery, design, delivery, and iteration to ensure solutions align with user needs, business goals, and technical constraints

  • Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices and support a wide range of user needs

  • Contribute to, evolve, and apply a consistent design system, ensuring solutions align with established patterns while identifying opportunities to improve system scalability and usability

  • Integrate AI-assisted design, research, synthesis, and prototyping tools into day-to-day workflows to accelerate exploration, uncover insights, and improve design effectiveness

  • Communicate design rationale effectively through presentations, storytelling, and facilitation

  • Actively contribute to evolving team workflows, tooling, and AI-assisted processes, treating how we work as something we continuously improve alongside what we design.

  • Collaborate with Product Experience Validation and squad teams within a risk-based review framework, treating validation as a design input rather than a final gate

QUALIFICATIONS

SKILLS & WORK TRAITS

  • Passionate about designing products that solve real user problems

  • Comfortable working independently within a cross-functional team

  • Strong understanding of interaction design, visual hierarchy, layout, and information architecture

  • Able to design for complex systems or multi-step workflows

  • Demonstrates a strong systems mindset and can work effectively within established patterns, design systems, and shared components while contributing improvements where needed

  • Naturally gravitates toward rapid exploration, experimentation, and learning, using low-fidelity approaches to test assumptions before refining solutions

  • Uses evidence from research, customer feedback, product usage patterns, and experimentation to inform design decisions

  • Regularly incorporates AI tools into design workflows to improve research, ideation, synthesis, prototyping, and productivity

  • Proficient in Figma and able to create clear design documentation

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Open to feedback and able to provide constructive critique

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
REQUIRED

• Proficient with Figma

• Familiarity with collaboration tools such as Jira or Miro
• Experience working with a component-based design system
• Familiarity with product analytics, behavioral data, or usage-tracking tools and the ability to use customer behavior data to inform design decisions and hypotheses

PREFERRED
• Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or modern front-end frameworks (understanding only; implementation not required)

EXPERIENCE
REQUIRED
• 2-5 years of experience in Product Design, User Experience Design, or a related role

• Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, workflow design, research-informed decision making, interaction design, and visual design skills. Portfolio should also show evidence of iterative problem solving, experimentation, and how insights or data influenced design outcomes.

• Strong understanding of design processes, from research to prototyping to testing

• Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools as a regular part of the design process, including research, ideation, synthesis, prototyping, or design execution

PREFERRED
• Experience designing for business software or other complex applications
• Experience working in agile or iterative development environments, with familiarity with custom configuration data, implementation workflows, or enterprise SaaS products.

• Experience using product analytics, customer behavior data, or experimentation results to identify opportunities, form design hypotheses, and evaluate outcomes

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or post-secondary training in Product Design, User Experience, or a related field preferred

Title:

Senior IT Development Lead

We are KBR

When you become part of our KBR team, your opportunities are endless.
